title.zh: 卷四十二 本紀第四十二: 順帝五
title.raw: 卷四十二 本紀第四十二: 順帝五 Volume 42 Annals 42: Shundi 5

sentences.zh: 順帝五

translations.literal: Shundi 5
translations.idiomatic: Shundi 5

sentences.zh: 九年春正月丁酉，享於太廟。

translations.literal: Ninth year, spring, first month, on dingyou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, on the dingyou day of the first month of spring, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，立山東河南等處行都水監，專治河患。

translations.literal: On guimao day, a regional Directorate of Waterways for Shandong, Henan, and other places was established, devoted exclusively to controlling river disasters.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, a regional directorate of waterways for Shandong, Henan, and other regions was established to deal exclusively with flooding on the rivers.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，廣西徭賊復陷道州，萬戶鄭均擊走之。

translations.literal: On yisi day, Guangxi Yao bandits again seized Daozhou; the commander of ten thousand Zheng Jun drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Yao bandits in Guangxi again captured Daozhou; Commander Zheng Jun routed them.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命中書平章政事太不花提調會同館。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, Taibuhua, chief minister of the Secretariat, was ordered to supervise the Joint Reception Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Taibuhua, chief minister of the Secretariat, was ordered to take charge of the Joint Reception Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，太白犯建星。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Venus transgressed the Establishment stars.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Venus transgressed the Establishment stars.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，太白犯平道。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, Venus transgressed the Level Road.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Venus transgressed the Level Road.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰，祭社稷。

translations.literal: Second month, on wuchen day, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the wuchen day, sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，太不花辭職，不允。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, Taibuhua resigned his post; the request was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Taibuhua resigned his post. The request was not granted.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太陰犯建星。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, the moon transgressed the Establishment stars.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the moon transgressed the Establishment stars.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，壩河淺澀，以軍士、民夫各一萬浚之。

translations.literal: Third month, on dingyou day, the dam river was shallow and sluggish; ten thousand soldiers and ten thousand corvée laborers were employed to dredge it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the dingyou day, the dam river ran shallow and sluggish, and ten thousand soldiers and ten thousand corvée laborers were sent to dredge it.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太白犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Venus transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Venus transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命大司農達識帖睦邇為湖廣行省平章政事。

translations.literal: On jisi day, Dash Temür, grand minister of agriculture, was appointed chief minister of the Huguang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, Dash Temür, grand minister of agriculture, was appointed chief minister of the Huguang branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 是月，河北潰。

translations.literal: That month, Hebei burst its banks.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Hebei region suffered a breach flood.

sentences.zh: 陳州麒麟生，不乳而死。

translations.literal: In Chenzhou a qilin was born; it did not nurse and died.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenzhou a qilin was born but would not nurse and soon died.

sentences.zh: 徭賊吳天保復寇沅州。

translations.literal: The Yao bandit Wu Tianbao again raided Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Yao bandit Wu Tianbao again attacked Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁卯，享於太廟。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, on dingmao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the dingmao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以知樞密院事欽察臺為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, Qichatai, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Qichatai, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以燕南廉訪使韓元善為中書左丞。

translations.literal: On jimao day, Han Yuanshan, surveillance commissioner of Yannan, was appointed left vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Han Yuanshan, surveillance commissioner of Yannan, was appointed left vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 立鎮撫司於直沽海津鎮。

translations.literal: A pacification commission was established at Zhigu Seaport Town.
translations.idiomatic: A pacification commission was established at Zhigu seaport town.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以河間鹽運司水災，住煎鹽三萬引。

translations.literal: On renwu day, because of flooding at the Hejian Salt Transport Office, boiling of thirty thousand yin of salt was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, because of flooding at the Hejian salt transport office, production of thirty thousand yin of salt was halted.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the emperor made his seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌，命太傅脫脫提調大斡耳朵內史府。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on wuxu day, Grand Preceptor Toqto was ordered to supervise the Inner Secretariat of the Great Ordo.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the wuxu day, Grand Preceptor Toqto was ordered to take charge of the inner secretariat of the great ordo.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔修黃河金堤，民夫日給鈔三貫。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, an edict ordered repair of the Yellow River's golden dikes; corvée laborers were to receive three ingots of paper money per day.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, an edict ordered repairs to the Yellow River's golden dikes, with corvée laborers paid three ingots of paper money per day.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，罷瑞州路上高縣長官司。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, the office of the chief of Shanggao County on the Raozhou route was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the office of the chief of Shanggao County on the Raozhou route was abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，命翰林國史院等官薦舉守令。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, officials of the Hanlin Academy and National History Office were ordered to recommend prefects and magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, officials of the Hanlin Academy and National History Office were ordered to recommend candidates for prefect and county magistrate posts.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，定守令督攝之法，路督攝府，府督攝州，州督攝縣。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, regulations were fixed for prefects and magistrates to supervise and oversee: circuits were to oversee prefectures, prefectures counties, and prefectures subprefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, regulations were established for hierarchical oversight among local officials: circuits were to supervise prefectures, prefectures subprefectures, and subprefectures counties.

sentences.zh: 是月，白茅河東註沛縣，遂成巨浸。

translations.literal: That month, the Baimao River flowed east into Pei County and thereupon became a vast inundation.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Baimao River poured east into Pei County and became a vast flood.

sentences.zh: 蜀江大溢，浸漢陽城，民大饑。

translations.literal: The Shu River greatly overflowed, inundating Hanyang city; the people suffered severe famine.
translations.idiomatic: The Shu River burst its banks and flooded Hanyang city, and the people suffered severe famine.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，刻小玉印，以「至正珍秘」為文，凡秘書監所掌書畫，皆識之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on bingzi day, a small jade seal was carved with the inscription "Zhizheng Treasured Secret"; all paintings and calligraphy under the charge of the Directorate of Archives were marked with it.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the bingzi day, a small jade seal was carved bearing the inscription "Zhizheng Treasured Secret," and all paintings and calligraphy held by the Directorate of Archives were stamped with it.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚寅朔，監察御史斡勒海壽劾奏殿中侍御史哈麻及其弟雪雪罪惡，御史大夫韓嘉訥以聞，不省，章三上，詔奪哈麻、雪雪官，出海壽為陜西廉訪副使，韓家訥為宣政院使。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on the first day gengyin of the month, Supervising Censor Walai Haishou impeached Attending Palace Censor Hama and his younger brother Xuexue for their crimes; Censor-in-Chief Han Jiana reported this, but the emperor took no notice; the memorial was submitted three times; an edict stripped Hama and Xuexue of their offices, sent Haishou out as vice surveillance commissioner of Shaanxi, and made Han Jiana commissioner of the Court for the Spread of Governance.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the gengyin new moon, Supervising Censor Walai Haishou impeached Attending Palace Censor Hama and his younger brother Xuexue for their crimes. Censor-in-Chief Han Jiana reported the matter, but the emperor paid no heed. After the memorial was submitted three times, an edict stripped Hama and Xuexue of office, sent Haishou out to serve as vice surveillance commissioner of Shaanxi, and appointed Han Jiana commissioner of the Court for the Spread of Governance.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔命太子愛猷識理達臘習學漢人文書，以李好文為諭德，歸旸為贊善，張仲為文學。

translations.literal: On renchen day, an edict ordered the crown prince Ayurshiridara to study Han Chinese texts, with Li Haowen as preceptor, Gui Yang as aide, and Zhang Zhong as literary instructor.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, an edict ordered Crown Prince Ayurshiridara to study Han Chinese texts, appointing Li Haowen as preceptor, Gui Yang as aide, and Zhang Zhong as literary instructor.

sentences.zh: 李好文等上書辭，不許。

translations.literal: Li Haowen and the others submitted memorials declining; the request was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Li Haowen and the others submitted memorials declining the appointments. The request was not granted.

sentences.zh: 賜公主不答昔你平江田五十頃。

translations.literal: Princess Budashini was granted fifty qing of fields in Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Princess Budashini was granted fifty qing of fields in Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以也先帖木兒為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, Yesen Temür was appointed censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Yesen Temür was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以湖廣行省左丞相亦憐真班知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, Yilianzhenban, left chief minister of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, was made director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, Yilianzhenban, left chief minister of the Huguang branch secretariat, was appointed director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙午，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, the moon transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, the moon transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，太陰犯天關。

translations.literal: On guichou day, the moon transgressed the Celestial Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the moon transgressed the Celestial Pass.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以柏顏為集賢大學士。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Bayan was appointed grand academician of the Hall of Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Bayan was appointed grand academician of the Hall of Worthies.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，罷右丞相朵兒只，依前為國王，左丞相太平為翰林學士承旨。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Dorji, right chief minister, was dismissed and restored to his former status as king; Taiping, left chief minister, was made chief Hanlin academician.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Dorji was dismissed as right chief minister and restored to his former status as king, while Taiping, left chief minister, was appointed chief Hanlin academician.

sentences.zh: 是月，大霖雨，水沒高唐州城；

translations.literal: That month, heavy rains fell in succession; water submerged Gaotang Prefecture city;
translations.idiomatic: That month, torrential rains fell in succession and water submerged the city of Gaotang Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 江、漢溢，漂沒民居、禾稼。

translations.literal: the Yangzi and Han overflowed, sweeping away dwellings and grain crops.
translations.idiomatic: the Yangzi and Han overflowed, sweeping away dwellings and standing crops.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛酉，詔脫脫為中書左丞相，仍太傅；

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on xinyou day, an edict appointed Toqto left chief minister of the Secretariat, while retaining the post of grand preceptor;
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the xinyou day, an edict appointed Toqto left chief minister of the Secretariat while retaining his post as grand preceptor;

sentences.zh: 韓家訥為江浙行省平章政事。

translations.literal: Han Jiana was made chief minister of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: and Han Jiana was appointed chief minister of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以也可劄魯忽赤搠思監為中書右丞，同知樞密院事，玉樞虎兒吐華為中書參知政事。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, Yekejaruqutu Suosijian was appointed right vice director of the Secretariat and associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Yushuhuertuhua was appointed vice grand councillor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, Yekejaruqutu Suosijian was appointed right vice director of the Secretariat and associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Yushuhuertuhua was appointed vice grand councillor of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔赦湖廣徭賊詿誤者。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, an edict pardoned those among the Huguang Yao bandits who had been misled into error.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, an edict pardoned those among the Huguang Yao bandits who had been misled into rebellion.

sentences.zh: 戊子，命岐王阿剌乞鎮西番。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Prince of Qi Alaqi was ordered to garrison the western Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Prince of Qi Alaqi was ordered to take command on the western Tibetan frontier.

sentences.zh: 八月甲辰，以集賢大學士柏顏為中書平章政事，河南行省平章政事月魯不花為宣政院使。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on jiachen day, Bayan, grand academician of the Hall of Worthies, was appointed chief minister of the Secretariat; Yue Lubuhua, chief minister of the Henan Branch Secretariat, was made commissioner of the Court for the Spread of Governance.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiachen day, Bayan, grand academician of the Hall of Worthies, was appointed chief minister of the Secretariat, and Yue Lubuhua, chief minister of the Henan branch secretariat, was appointed commissioner of the Court for the Spread of Governance.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以司徒雅普化提調太史院、知經筵事。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Minister of Education Yabhua was ordered to supervise the Astronomical Bureau and direct the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Minister of Education Yabhua was ordered to supervise the Astronomical Bureau and direct the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕還自上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the emperor returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，凡建言中外利害者，詔委官選其可行之事以聞。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jiazi day, as to all who offered advice on advantages and harms within and without the court, an edict commissioned officials to select feasible proposals and report them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiazi day, an edict ordered officials to review all memorials on matters of public advantage or harm at court and in the provinces, select those proposals that could be carried out, and report them.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，命平章政事柏顏提調留守司。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, Bayan, chief minister, was ordered to supervise the Metropolitan Garrison Command.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Chief Minister Bayan was ordered to take charge of the metropolitan garrison command.

sentences.zh: 丙子，中書平章政事定住以疾辭職，不允。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, Dingzhu, chief minister of the Secretariat, resigned on grounds of illness; the request was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, Dingzhu, chief minister of the Secretariat, resigned on grounds of illness. The request was not granted.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命知樞密院事亦憐真班提調武備寺。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, Yilianzhenban, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was ordered to supervise the Arsenal Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Yilianzhenban, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was ordered to take charge of the Arsenal Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，熒惑犯靈臺。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Mars transgressed the Celestial Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Mars transgressed the Celestial Terrace.

sentences.zh: 是月，遣御史中丞李獻代祀河瀆。

translations.literal: That month, Vice Censor-in-Chief Li Xian was dispatched to perform sacrifice at the river god on the emperor's behalf.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Vice Censor-in-Chief Li Xian was dispatched to perform sacrifice at the river god on the emperor's behalf.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，享於太廟。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, on xinmao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinmao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命皇太子愛猷識理達臘自是日為始入端本堂肄業。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, the crown prince Ayurshiridara was ordered, beginning from this day, to enter the Hall of the Correct Root for his studies.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Crown Prince Ayurshiridara was ordered, beginning on that day, to pursue his studies in the Hall of the Correct Root.

sentences.zh: 命脫脫領端本堂事，司徒雅普化知端本堂事。

translations.literal: Toqto was ordered to head the Hall of the Correct Root; Minister of Education Yabhua was made its director.
translations.idiomatic: Toqto was ordered to head the Hall of the Correct Root, and Minister of Education Yabhua was appointed its director.

sentences.zh: 端本堂虛中座，以俟至尊臨幸，太子與師傅分東西向坐授書，其下僚屬以次列坐。

translations.literal: The central seat in the Hall of the Correct Root was left vacant to await the sovereign's visit; the crown prince and his tutors sat facing east and west to give instruction in the texts, while subordinate officials sat in order below.
translations.idiomatic: The central seat in the Hall of the Correct Root was left vacant to await the emperor's visit. The crown prince and his tutors sat facing east and west to conduct lessons, while the subordinate staff sat in order below them.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on the first day wuwu of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the wuwu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，太陰犯畢宿。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, the moon transgressed the Net mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the moon transgressed the Net mansion.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，太白犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Venus transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Venus transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，太白復犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on wuxu day, Venus again transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the wuxu day, Venus again transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 丁未，徭賊吳天保陷辰州。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, the Yao bandit Wu Tianbao seized Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, the Yao bandit Wu Tianbao captured Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 是歲，詔汰冗官，均俸祿，賜致仕官及高年帛。

translations.literal: That year, an edict ordered elimination of redundant officials, equalization of salaries, and gifts of silk to retired officials and the elderly.
translations.idiomatic: That year, an edict ordered the elimination of redundant officials, equalization of salaries, and gifts of silk to retired officials and the elderly.

sentences.zh: 漕運使賈魯建言便益二十餘事，從其八事：其一曰京畿和糴，二曰優恤漕司舊領漕戶，三曰接運委官，四曰通州總治豫定委官，五曰船戶困於壩夫、海糧壞於壩主戶，六曰疏浚運河，七曰臨清運糧萬戶府當隸漕司，八曰宜以宣忠船戶付本司節制。

translations.literal: Grain Transport Commissioner Jia Lu proposed more than twenty measures for convenience and benefit; eight were adopted: first, government purchase of grain in the capital region; second, favorable treatment for households formerly under the transport office; third, appointing officials for relay transport; fourth, appointing overall and advance commissioners for Tongzhou; fifth, ship households oppressed by dam laborers and sea grain spoiled by dam household heads; sixth, dredging the transport canal; seventh, the grain transport office of ten thousand households at Linqing should be subordinate to the transport office; eighth, the loyal ship households should be placed under this office's control.
translations.idiomatic: Grain Transport Commissioner Jia Lu proposed more than twenty measures for improving the system, and eight were adopted: first, government grain purchases in the capital region; second, favorable treatment for households formerly registered with the transport office; third, appointing officials to oversee relay transport; fourth, appointing overall and advance commissioners at Tongzhou; fifth, relieving ship households from oppression by dam laborers and preventing sea grain from being spoiled by dam household heads; sixth, dredging the transport canal; seventh, subordinating the Linqing grain transport office of ten thousand households to the main transport office; and eighth, placing the loyal ship households under that office's control.

sentences.zh: 冀寧平遙等縣曹七七反，命刑部郎中八十、兵馬指揮沙不丁討平之。

translations.literal: In Pingyao and other counties of Jining Circuit, Cao Qiqi rebelled; the Ministry of Justice director Bashiba and military commander Shabuding were ordered to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Qiqi rebelled in Pingyao and other counties of Jining Circuit, and Director Bashiba of the Ministry of Justice and military commander Shabuding were ordered to suppress the revolt.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月丙辰朔，以中書右丞搠思監為平章政事，玉樞虎兒吐華為中書右丞。

translations.literal: Tenth year, spring, first month, on the first day bingchen of the month, Suosijian, right vice director of the Secretariat, was made chief minister; Yushuhuertuhua was made right vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, on the bingchen new moon of the first month of spring, Suosijian, right vice director of the Secretariat, was promoted to chief minister, and Yushuhuertuhua was appointed right vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，立四川容美洞軍民總管府。

translations.literal: On renxu day, a general pacification office for military and civilians of Rongmei Cave in Sichuan was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, a general pacification office for the military and civilians of Rongmei Cave in Sichuan was established.

sentences.zh: 壬申，太陰犯熒惑。

translations.literal: On renshen day, the moon transgressed Mars.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, the moon transgressed Mars.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，隕石棣州，色黑，中微有金星；

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, a meteorite fell in Dizhou; it was black, with a slight trace of gold within;
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, a meteorite fell in Dizhou. It was black, with a slight trace of gold within;

sentences.zh: 先有聲自西北來，至州北二十里乃隕。

translations.literal: first there was a sound coming from the northwest; when it reached twenty li north of the prefecture, it fell.
translations.idiomatic: a sound had first been heard from the northwest, and the stone fell twenty li north of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌朔，詔加封天妃父種德積慶侯，母育聖顯慶夫人。

translations.literal: Second month, on the first day bingxu of the month, an edict added enfeoffments for the Queen of Heaven's father as Marquis of Accumulated Virtue and Accumulated Blessings, and her mother as Lady of Nurturing Sagacity and Manifest Blessings.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the bingxu new moon, an edict added posthumous titles for the Queen of Heaven's father as Marquis of Accumulated Virtue and Accumulated Blessings and for her mother as Lady of Nurturing Sagacity and Manifest Blessings.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，太陰犯平道。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, the moon transgressed the Level Road.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the moon transgressed the Level Road.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，太陰犯鍵閉。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, the moon transgressed the Door Bolt.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, the moon transgressed the Door Bolt.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，熒惑犯太微垣。

translations.literal: Third month, on jimao day, Mars transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jimao day, Mars transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 是月，奉化州山石裂，有禽鳥、草木、山川、人物之形。

translations.literal: That month, a mountain stone in Fenghua Prefecture split open, bearing shapes of birds, plants, mountains, rivers, and human figures.
translations.idiomatic: That month, a mountain stone in Fenghua Prefecture split open, revealing shapes of birds, plants, mountains, rivers, and human figures.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，左司都事武祺建言更鈔法。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, on jichou day, Wu Qi, director of the Left Secretariat Office, proposed reform of the paper-money system.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jichou day, Wu Qi, director of the left secretariat office, proposed reform of the paper-money system.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，赦天下，其略曰：「朕纂承洪業，撫臨萬邦，夙夜厲精，靡遑暇逸。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm; the gist read: "We have inherited the great enterprise and rule over the myriad states, striving day and night with diligence and never allowing ourselves leisure.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm. The gist read: "We have inherited the great enterprise and rule over the myriad states, striving day and night with diligence and never allowing ourselves leisure.

sentences.zh: 比緣倚註失當，治理乖方，是用圖任一相，俾贊萬機。

translations.literal: Recently, because reliance and appointment were ill judged and governance went awry, We therefore sought to appoint one chief minister to assist in the myriad affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, because ill-judged appointments threw governance off course, We therefore sought to entrust the myriad affairs of state to a single chief minister.

sentences.zh: 爰命脫脫為中書右丞相，統正百官，允厘庶績，曾未期月，百度具舉，中外協望，朕甚嘉焉。

translations.literal: Thereupon We appointed Toqto right chief minister of the Secretariat, to bring all officials into order and duly settle the myriad tasks; in less than a full month, the hundred affairs were all set in motion, and within and without the court were united in expectation — We greatly commend this.
translations.idiomatic: We thereupon appointed Toqto right chief minister of the Secretariat to bring all officials into order and settle the myriad tasks of government. In less than a full month, the hundred affairs of state were all set in motion, and court and country alike looked to him with hope — for which We are deeply gratified.

sentences.zh: 尚慮軍國之重，民物之繁，政令有未孚，生意有未遂，可赦天下。

translations.literal: Yet We still fear the weight of military and state affairs and the multitude of the people and things; governmental orders may not yet have won assent, and living enterprises may not yet have been fulfilled — a general amnesty throughout the realm is hereby granted."
translations.idiomatic: Yet We still fear that, given the weight of military and state affairs and the multitude of the people, some governmental orders may not yet have won full assent and some livelihoods may not yet have been secured. A general amnesty throughout the realm is hereby granted."

sentences.zh: 」丙午，太白犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: "On bingwu day, Venus transgressed the Ghost mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Venus transgressed the Ghost mansion.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the emperor made his seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，星大如月，入北斗，震聲若雷，三日復還。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on renzi day, a star as large as the moon entered the Northern Dipper; a thunderous sound shook the heavens; after three days it returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the renzi day, a star as large as the moon entered the Northern Dipper with a thunderous sound like rolling thunder, then returned after three days.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉，太陰犯房宿。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on xinyou day, the moon transgressed the Chamber mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the xinyou day, the moon transgressed the Chamber mansion.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以大護國仁王寺昭應宮財用規運總管府仍屬宣政院。

translations.literal: On guihai day, the general supervisory office for finances and transport of the Zhaoying Palace of the Great State-Protecting Temple of the Benevolent King was again placed under the Court for the Spread of Governance.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, the general supervisory office for finances and transport of the Zhaoying Palace of the Great State-Protecting Temple of the Benevolent King was again placed under the Court for the Spread of Governance.

sentences.zh: 辛未，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，太白復晝見。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, Venus was again seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Venus was again visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，車駕還自上都。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on renyin day, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the renyin day, the emperor returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑朔，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on the first day guichou of the month, Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the guichou new moon, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，祭三皇，如祭孔子禮。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, the Three Sovereigns were sacrificed to with the same rites as for Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, the Three Sovereigns were sacrificed to with the same rites used for Confucius.

sentences.zh: 先是，歲祀以醫官行事，江西廉訪使文殊訥建言，禮有未備，乃敕工部具祭器，江浙行省造雅樂，太常定儀式，翰林撰樂章，至是用之。

translations.literal: Earlier, the annual sacrifice had been conducted by medical officials; Wenshunu, surveillance commissioner of Jiangxi, proposed that the rites were incomplete; thereupon the Ministry of Works was ordered to prepare sacrificial vessels, the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat to make elegant music, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to fix the ritual forms, and the Hanlin to compose hymn texts — and on this occasion they were used.
translations.idiomatic: Previously the annual sacrifice had been conducted by medical officials. Wenshunu, surveillance commissioner of Jiangxi, proposed that the rites were incomplete, whereupon the Ministry of Works was ordered to prepare sacrificial vessels, the Jiangzhe branch secretariat to compose elegant music, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to fix the ritual forms, and the Hanlin Academy to compose hymn texts — all of which were now employed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，熒惑犯天江。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Mars transgressed the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Mars transgressed the Celestial River.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命樞密院以軍士五百修築白河堤。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, the Bureau of Military Affairs was ordered to employ five hundred soldiers to repair the Bai River dikes.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, the Bureau of Military Affairs was ordered to deploy five hundred soldiers to repair the dikes on the Bai River.

sentences.zh: 壬午，脫脫以吏部選格條目繁多，莫適據依，銓選者得以高下之，請編類為成書，從之。

translations.literal: On renwu day, Toqto, because the Ministry of Personnel's selection regulations had numerous entries and no clear basis to rely on, so that selectors could grade candidates high or low at will, requested that they be compiled into a definitive book; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, Toqto reported that the Ministry of Personnel's selection regulations had grown so numerous that selectors had no clear basis to rely on and could grade candidates at will. He requested that the regulations be compiled into a definitive book, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸巳，歲星犯軒轅。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, on guisi day, Jupiter transgressed the Chariot Shafts asterism.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the guisi day, Jupiter transgressed the Chariot Shafts asterism.

sentences.zh: 乙未，吏部尚書偰哲篤建言更鈔法，命中書省、御史臺、集賢、翰林兩院之臣集議之。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, Qieduzhe, minister of the Ministry of Personnel, proposed reform of the paper-money system; officials of the Secretariat, Censorate, Hall of Worthies, and both Hanlin academies were ordered to assemble for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, Qieduzhe, minister of the Ministry of Personnel, proposed reform of the paper-money system, and officials of the Secretariat, Censorate, Hall of Worthies, and both Hanlin academies were ordered to assemble for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 丙申，太陰犯昴宿。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, the moon transgressed the Hairy Head mansion.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，置諸路寶泉都提舉司於京城。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, the directorate-general for Treasured Spring of all circuits was established in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the directorate-general for Treasured Spring of all circuits was established in the capital.

sentences.zh: 是月，大名、東平、濟南、徐州各立兵馬指揮司以捕上馬賊。

translations.literal: That month, Daming, Dongping, Jinan, and Xuzhou each established troop-and-horse command offices to capture mounted highway bandits.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Daming, Dongping, Jinan, and Xuzhou each established troop-and-horse command offices to hunt down mounted highway bandits.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on the first day renzi of the month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the renzi new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以高麗沈王之孫脫脫不花等為東宮怯薛官。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Toqtoghbuqa, grandson of King Shen of Goryeo, and others were made keshik officers of the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Toqtoghbuqa, grandson of King Shen of Goryeo, and others were appointed keshik officers of the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，罷遼陽濱海民煎熬野鹽。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, the Liaoyang coastal people's boiling of wild salt was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, the Liaoyang coastal people's practice of boiling wild salt was abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，太陰犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, the moon transgressed the Ghost mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the moon transgressed the Ghost mansion.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔天下以中統交鈔一貫文權銅錢一千文，準至元寶鈔貳貫，仍鑄至正通寶錢並用，以實鈔法，至元寶鈔通行如故。

translations.literal: On jisi day, an edict ordered that throughout the realm one string of Zhongtong convertible notes should be equivalent to one thousand cash in copper coins and equivalent to two strings of Zhiyuan treasure notes; Zhizheng general circulation coins were still to be cast and used together, to strengthen the note system, while Zhiyuan treasure notes continued to circulate as before.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, an edict ordered that throughout the realm one string of Zhongtong convertible notes should be equivalent to one thousand copper cash and to two strings of Zhiyuan treasure notes. Zhizheng general circulation coins were to be cast and used alongside them to strengthen the paper-money system, while Zhiyuan treasure notes continued to circulate as before.

sentences.zh: 是月，三星隕於耀州，化為石，如斧形，削之有屑，擊之有聲。

translations.literal: That month, three stars fell at Yaozhou, turned to stone, were shaped like axes, produced shavings when pared, and made a sound when struck.
translations.idiomatic: That month, three stars fell at Yaozhou and turned to stone shaped like axes; they produced shavings when pared and rang when struck.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午朔，修大都城。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on the first day renwu of the month, the capital city of Dadu was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the renwu new moon, repairs were undertaken on the capital city of Dadu.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以大司農禿魯等兼領都水監，集河防正官議黃河便益事。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Tulu, grand minister of agriculture, and others were additionally put in charge of the Directorate of Waterways; river-defense chief officials were assembled to discuss measures for the convenience and benefit of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Tulu, grand minister of agriculture, and others were additionally placed in charge of the Directorate of Waterways, and chief river-defense officials were assembled to discuss measures for improving the Yellow River system.

sentences.zh: 命前同知樞密院事不顏不花等討廣西徭賊。

translations.literal: The former associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Buyan Buyan and others were ordered to campaign against the Guangxi Yao bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The former associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Buyan Buyan and others were ordered to campaign against the Yao bandits in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 乙未，太陰犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, the moon transgressed the Ghost mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, the moon transgressed the Ghost mansion.

sentences.zh: 己酉，方國珍攻溫州。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Fang Guozhen attacked Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Fang Guozhen attacked Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 是歲，京師麗正門樓上忽有人妄言災禍，鞫問之，自稱薊州人，已而不知所往。

translations.literal: That year, on the tower of the Lizheng Gate in the capital someone suddenly spoke rashly of disaster and calamity; when interrogated, he declared himself a man of Jizhou, and thereafter his whereabouts were unknown.
translations.idiomatic: That year, someone on the tower of the Lizheng Gate in the capital suddenly cried out prophecies of disaster. When interrogated, he claimed to be from Jizhou, and thereafter vanished without trace.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月乙卯，享於太廟。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, spring, first month, on yimao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, on the yimao day of the first month of spring, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，辰星犯牛宿。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Mercury transgressed the Ox mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Mercury transgressed the Ox mansion.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命江浙行省左丞孛羅帖木兒討方國珍。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Boluo Temür, left vice director of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, was ordered to campaign against Fang Guozhen.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Boluo Temür, left vice director of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, was ordered to campaign against Fang Guozhen.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，蘭陽縣有紅星大如鬥，自東南墜西北，其聲如雷。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, in Lanyang County there was a red star as large as a dipper, falling from the southeast toward the northwest; its sound was like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, in Lanyang County a red star as large as a dipper fell from the southeast toward the northwest with a thunderous roar.

sentences.zh: 己卯，命搠思監提調大都留守司。

translations.literal: On jimao day, Suosijian was ordered to take charge of the Dadu Directorate of Palace Maintenance.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Suosijian was ordered to take charge of the Dadu Directorate of Palace Maintenance.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，太陰犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: Second month, on gengyin day, the moon transgressed the Ghost mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the gengyin day, the moon transgressed the Ghost mansion.

sentences.zh: 乙未，太陰犯太微。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太陰犯亢宿。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, the moon transgressed the Neck mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, the moon transgressed the Neck mansion.

sentences.zh: 是月，命遊皇城，中書省臣諫止之，不聽。

translations.literal: That month, an order was issued to tour the Imperial City; ministers of the Secretariat remonstrated to stop it, but the order was not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: That month, an order was issued for a tour of the Imperial City. Ministers of the Secretariat remonstrated against it, but the emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 立湖南元帥府分府於寶慶路。

translations.literal: A sub-office of the Hunan Marshalate was established at Baqing Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: A sub-office of the Hunan Marshalate was established at Baqing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌，立山東分元帥府於登州。

translations.literal: Third month, on gengxu day, a sub-marshalate of Shandong was established at Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengxu day, a sub-marshalate of Shandong was established at Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，親策進士八十三人，賜朵烈圖、文允中進士及第，其餘賜出身有差。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, the palace examination was personally conducted for eighty-three jinshi; Duolietu and Wen Yunzhong were granted jinshi with highest honors, and the rest were granted degrees with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, the emperor personally examined eighty-three jinshi candidates. Duolietu and Wen Yunzhong were granted jinshi with highest honors, and the rest received degrees with distinctions.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，征建寧處士彭炳為端本堂說書，不至。

translations.literal: On renxu day, the recluse Peng Bing of Jianning was summoned to be lecturer at the Hall of the Correct Root; he did not come.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, the recluse Peng Bing of Jianning was summoned to serve as lecturer at the Hall of the Correct Root, but he did not come.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太陰犯東咸。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the moon transgressed the Eastern Rampart.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, the moon transgressed the Eastern Rampart.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，太陰犯天江。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, the moon transgressed the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the moon transgressed the Celestial River.

sentences.zh: 是月，遣使賑湖南、北被寇人民，死者鈔五錠，傷者三錠，毀所居屋者一錠。

translations.literal: That month, envoys were dispatched to relieve the people of southern and northern Hunan who had suffered bandit raids: five ingots of notes for the dead, three for the wounded, and one for those whose dwellings had been destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: That month, envoys were dispatched to relieve the people of southern and northern Hunan who had suffered bandit raids, granting five ingots of notes to families of the dead, three to the wounded, and one to those whose homes had been destroyed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬午，詔開黃河故道，命賈魯以工部尚書為總治河防使，發汴梁、大名十三路民十五萬，廬州等戍十八翼軍二萬，自黃陵岡南達白茅，放於黃固、哈只等口，又自黃陵西至陽青村，合於故道，凡二百八十里有奇，仍命中書右丞玉樞虎兒吐華、同知樞密院事黑廝以兵鎮之。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, on renwu day, an edict ordered the reopening of the old course of the Yellow River; Jia Lu was appointed overall commissioner for river defense with the rank of minister of the Ministry of Works; one hundred fifty thousand corvée laborers were levied from the thirteen circuits of Bianliang, Daming, and others, and twenty thousand soldiers from eighteen wings garrisoned at Luzhou and elsewhere; from Huangling Hill south to Baimao the river was released at the mouths of Huanggu, Hazhi, and others, and from Huangling west to Yangqing Village it was joined to the old course — in all more than two hundred eighty li — and Yushuhuertuhua, right vice director of the Secretariat, and Heisi, associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, were ordered to garrison it with troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the renwu day, an edict ordered the reopening of the old course of the Yellow River. Jia Lu was appointed overall commissioner for river defense with the rank of minister of the Ministry of Works. One hundred fifty thousand corvée laborers were levied from the thirteen circuits of Bianliang, Daming, and elsewhere, and twenty thousand soldiers from eighteen garrison wings at Luzhou and other posts. From Huangling Hill south to Baimao the river was released at the mouths of Huanggu, Hazhi, and other outlets, and from Huangling west to Yangqing Village it was joined to the old course — more than two hundred eighty li in all. Yushuhuertuhua, right vice director of the Secretariat, and Heisi, associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, were ordered to garrison the works with troops.

sentences.zh: 冀寧路屬縣多地震，半月乃止。

translations.literal: Many counties subordinate to Jining Circuit suffered earthquakes; after half a month they ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Many counties under Jining Circuit suffered earthquakes, which continued for half a month before ceasing.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 詔加封河瀆神為靈源神佑弘濟王，仍重建河瀆及西海神廟。

translations.literal: An edict added enfeoffment to the spirit of the River Lord as King Lingyuan Shenyou Hongji, and ordered the rebuilding of the temples of the River Lord and the Western Sea God.
translations.idiomatic: An edict elevated the River Lord to the rank of King Lingyuan Shenyou Hongji and ordered the rebuilding of the temples of the River Lord and the Western Sea God.

sentences.zh: 改永順安撫司為宣撫司。

translations.literal: The Yongshun Pacification Commission was changed to a Pacification and Settlement Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongshun Pacification Commission was redesignated as a Pacification and Settlement Commission.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，孟州地震。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Mengzhou suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Mengzhou suffered an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 庚子，罷海西遼東道巡防捕盜所，立鎮寧州。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, the Haixi Liaodong Circuit patrol office for capturing bandits was abolished, and Zhenning Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, the Haixi Liaodong Circuit patrol office for capturing bandits was abolished and Zhenning Prefecture was established in its place.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，師壁安撫司土官田驢什用、盤順府土官墨奴什用降，立長官司四、巡檢司七。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, the native official Tian Lushiyong of the Shibi Pacification Commission and the native official Mo Nushiyong of Panshun Prefecture submitted; four native chieftainships and seven inspection offices were established.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the native official Tian Lushiyong of the Shibi Pacification Commission and the native official Mo Nushiyong of Panshun Prefecture submitted. Four native chieftainships and seven inspection offices were established.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，彰德路雨雹，形如斧，傷人畜。

translations.literal: On yisi day, Zhangde Circuit had hail in the shape of axes, injuring people and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Zhangde Circuit was struck by axe-shaped hail that injured people and livestock.

sentences.zh: 是月，罷沂州分元帥府，改立兵馬指揮使司，復分司於膠州。

translations.literal: That month, the sub-marshalate of Yizhou was abolished and a troop-and-horse commandery was established in its place; a sub-office was again established at Jiaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the sub-marshalate of Yizhou was abolished and replaced with a troop-and-horse commandery, and a sub-office was reestablished at Jiaozhou.

sentences.zh: 車駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage was then touring Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was then on tour at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 五月己酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on the first day jiyou of the month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiyou new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，潁州妖人劉福通為亂，以紅巾為號，陷潁州。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, the sorcerer Liu Futong of Yingzhou raised rebellion, taking the red turban as his sign, and seized Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, the sorcerer Liu Futong of Yingzhou raised rebellion under the banner of the red turban and captured Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 初，欒城人韓山童祖父，以白蓮會燒香惑眾，謫徙廣平永年縣。

translations.literal: Earlier, the grandfather of Han Shantong of Luancheng, by burning incense in the White Lotus Society to delude the masses, was banished and relocated to Yongnian County in Guangping.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, the grandfather of Han Shantong of Luancheng had used incense-burning in the White Lotus Society to delude the masses and was banished to Yongnian County in Guangping.

sentences.zh: 至山童，倡言天下大亂，彌勒佛下生，河南及江淮愚民皆翕然信之。

translations.literal: When it came to Shantong, he proclaimed that the realm would fall into great disorder and that Maitreya Buddha would descend to be born; the foolish people of Henan and the Yangtze-Huai region all believed him at once.
translations.idiomatic: By Han Shantong's time, he was proclaiming that the realm would fall into great disorder and that Maitreya Buddha would descend to earth, and the common people of Henan and the Yangtze-Huai region all believed him at once.

sentences.zh: 福通與杜遵道、羅文素、盛文郁、王顯忠、韓咬兒復鼓妖言，謂山童實宋徽宗八世孫，當為中國主。

translations.literal: Futong, together with Du Zundao, Luo Wensu, Sheng Wenyu, Wang Xianzhong, and Han Yao'er, again spread sorcerous talk, saying that Shantong was in truth the eighth-generation descendant of Emperor Huizong of Song and ought to become ruler of China.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Futong, together with Du Zundao, Luo Wensu, Sheng Wenyu, Wang Xianzhong, and Han Yao'er, again spread sorcerous talk, declaring that Han Shantong was in truth the eighth-generation descendant of Emperor Huizong of Song and ought to become ruler of China.

sentences.zh: 福通等殺白馬、黑牛，誓告天地，欲同起兵為亂，事覺，縣官捕之急，福通遂反。

translations.literal: Futong and the others killed a white horse and a black ox and swore their oath before Heaven and Earth, intending together to raise troops in rebellion; the affair was discovered, county officials pressed the pursuit urgently, and Futong thereupon rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Futong and his followers killed a white horse and a black ox and swore an oath before Heaven and Earth, intending to raise troops together in rebellion. When the plot was discovered and county officials pressed the pursuit, Liu Futong rose in open revolt.

sentences.zh: 山童就擒，其妻楊氏，其子韓林兒，逃之武安。

translations.literal: Shantong was captured; his wife, Lady Yang, and his son Han Lin'er fled to Wu'an.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shantong was captured. His wife, Lady Yang, and his son Han Lin'er fled to Wu'an.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，文水縣雨雹。

translations.literal: On guichou day, Wenshui County had hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Wenshui County was struck by hail.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命同知樞密院事禿赤以兵討劉福通，授以分樞密院印。

translations.literal: On renshen day, Tuochi, associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was ordered to campaign against Liu Futong with troops, and was granted the seal of the branch Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Tuochi, associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was ordered to campaign against Liu Futong with troops and was granted the seal of the branch Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙子，命大都至汴梁二十四驛，凡馬一匹助給鈔五錠。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, for the twenty-four relay stations from the capital to Bianliang, five ingots of notes were granted in aid for each horse.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, for the twenty-four relay stations from the capital to Bianliang, an aid grant of five ingots of notes was authorized for each horse.

sentences.zh: 六月，發軍一千，從直沽至通州，疏浚河道。

translations.literal: Sixth month, one thousand soldiers were dispatched from Zhigu to Tongzhou to dredge the waterway.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, one thousand soldiers were dispatched from Zhigu to Tongzhou to dredge the waterway.

sentences.zh: 是月，劉福通據朱臯，攻破羅山、真陽、確山，遂犯舞陽、葉縣等處。

translations.literal: That month, Liu Futong held Zhugao, captured Luoshan, Zhenyang, and Queshan, and then attacked Wuyang, Ye County, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Liu Futong seized Zhugao, captured Luoshan, Zhenyang, and Queshan, and then attacked Wuyang, Ye County, and other places.

sentences.zh: 江浙左丞孛羅帖木兒為方國珍所敗。

translations.literal: Boluo Temür, left vice director of Jiangzhe, was defeated by Fang Guozhen.
translations.idiomatic: Boluo Temür, left vice director of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, was defeated by Fang Guozhen.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，廣西大水。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on bingchen day, Guangxi suffered great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the bingchen day, Guangxi suffered severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，罷四川大奴管勾洞長官司，改立忠孝軍民府。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, the Danu superintendent office for native chieftainships in Sichuan was abolished, and the Zhongxiao Military-Civilian Prefecture was established in its place.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, the Danu superintendent office for native chieftainships in Sichuan was abolished and replaced with the Zhongxiao Military-Civilian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己未，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太白犯右執法，己巳，太白犯左執法。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Venus transgressed the Right Law Administrator; on jisi day, Venus transgressed the Left Law Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Venus transgressed the Right Law Administrator. On the jisi day, Venus transgressed the Left Law Administrator.

sentences.zh: 熒惑入鬼宿。

translations.literal: Mars entered the Ghost mansion.
translations.idiomatic: Mars entered the Ghost mansion.

sentences.zh: 是月，開河功成，乃議塞決河。

translations.literal: That month, the river-opening project was completed, and deliberation then turned to blocking the breach river.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the river-opening project was completed, and officials then deliberated on blocking the breach channel.

sentences.zh: 命大司農達識帖睦邇及江浙行省參知政事樊執敬、浙東廉訪使董守愨同招諭方國珍。

translations.literal: Dash Temür, grand minister of agriculture, Fan Zhijing, vice grand councillor of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, and Dong Shouque, surveillance commissioner of eastern Zhejiang, were ordered together to summon and persuade Fang Guozhen.
translations.idiomatic: Dash Temür, grand minister of agriculture, Fan Zhijing, vice grand councillor of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, and Dong Shouque, surveillance commissioner of eastern Zhejiang, were jointly ordered to summon and persuade Fang Guozhen to submit.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑朔，中興地震。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on the first day dingchou of the month, Zhongxing suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the dingchou new moon, Zhongxing suffered an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，祭社稷。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, sacrifices were offered at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，太陰犯天江。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, the moon transgressed the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, the moon transgressed the Celestial River.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，蕭縣李二及老彭、趙君用攻陷徐州。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Li Er of Xiao County, together with Old Peng and Zhao Junyong, attacked and seized Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Li Er of Xiao County, together with Old Peng and Zhao Junyong, attacked and captured Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 李二號芝麻李，與其黨亦以燒香聚眾而反。

translations.literal: Li Er was called Sesame Li; he and his followers also gathered a crowd by burning incense and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Li Er was known as Sesame Li. He and his followers also gathered followers through incense-burning and rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 是月，車駕還自上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the emperor returned from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 蘄州羅田縣人徐貞一，名壽輝，與黃州麻城人鄒普勝等，以妖術陰謀聚眾，遂舉兵為亂，以紅巾為號。

translations.literal: Xu Zhenyi of Luotian County in Qizhou, whose name was Shouhui, together with Zou Pusheng of Macheng in Huangzhou and others, by sorcerous arts secretly plotted to gather a crowd, then raised troops in rebellion, taking the red turban as their sign.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Zhenyi of Luotian County in Qizhou, also known as Xu Shouhui, together with Zou Pusheng of Macheng in Huangzhou and others, secretly gathered followers through sorcerous rites and then raised troops in rebellion under the banner of the red turban.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，以中書平章政事朵兒直班提調宣文閣、知經筵事，平章政事定住提調會同館事。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on wushen day, Duorjiban, chief minister of the Secretariat, was ordered to take charge of the Hall of Promoting Culture and direct the Classics Colloquium; Dingzhu, chief minister of the Secretariat, was ordered to take charge of the Joint Reception Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the wushen day, Duorjiban, chief minister of the Secretariat, was ordered to take charge of the Hall of Promoting Culture and direct the Classics Colloquium, and Dingzhu, chief minister of the Secretariat, was ordered to take charge of the Joint Reception Hall.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命御史大夫也先帖木兒知樞密院事，及衛王寬徹哥總率大軍出征河南妖寇，各賜鈔一千錠，從征者賜予有差。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Yesun Temür, censor-in-chief, was appointed director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Prince of Wei Kuanchige was ordered to command the great army in campaigning against the sorcerous bandits of Henan; each was granted one thousand ingots of notes, and those who joined the campaign were rewarded with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Yesun Temür, censor-in-chief, was appointed director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Prince of Wei Kuanchige was ordered to command a great army against the sorcerous bandits of Henan. Each was granted one thousand ingots of notes, and those who joined the campaign received rewards according to rank.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，辰星犯左執法。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Mercury transgressed the Left Law Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Mercury transgressed the Left Law Administrator.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，太白犯房宿。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Venus transgressed the Room mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Venus transgressed the Room mansion.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔以高麗國王不答失裏之弟伯顏帖木兒襲其王封，不答失裏之子遂廢。

translations.literal: On renxu day, an edict ordered that Bayan Temür, younger brother of King Budashili of Goryeo, should inherit his royal enfeoffment, and Budashili's son was thereupon deposed.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, an edict ordered that Bayan Temür, younger brother of King Budashili of Goryeo, should inherit the kingship, and Budashili's son was thereupon deposed.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，太陰犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, the moon transgressed the Ghost mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, the moon transgressed the Ghost mansion.

sentences.zh: 是月，劉福通陷汝寧府及息州、光州，眾至十萬。

translations.literal: That month, Liu Futong seized Runing Prefecture and Xizhou and Guangzhou; his force reached one hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Liu Futong captured Runing Prefecture as well as Xizhou and Guangzhou, and his forces grew to one hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 徐壽輝陷蘄水縣及黃州路。

translations.literal: Xu Shouhui seized Qishui County and Huangzhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shouhui captured Qishui County and Huangzhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，熒惑犯太微垣。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, on wuyin day, Mars transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the wuyin day, Mars transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 己卯，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On jimao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, the moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 癸未，立寶泉提舉司於河南行省及濟南、冀寧等路凡九，江浙、江西、湖廣行省等處凡三。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, Treasured Spring directorates were established at the Henan branch secretariat and at Jinan, Jining, and other circuits — nine in all — and at the Jiangzhe, Jiangxi, and Huguang branch secretariats and other places — three in all.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Treasured Spring directorates were established at the Henan branch secretariat and at Jinan, Jining, and other circuits — nine in all — and at the Jiangzhe, Jiangxi, and Huguang branch secretariats and elsewhere — three in all.

sentences.zh: 命知樞密院事老章以兵同也先帖木兒討河南妖寇。

translations.literal: Lao Zhang, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was ordered to campaign with troops together with Yesun Temür against the sorcerous bandits of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Lao Zhang, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was ordered to join Yesun Temür in campaigning against the sorcerous bandits of Henan with troops.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，太白犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Venus transgressed the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Venus transgressed the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 己丑，太白晝見，熒惑犯歲星。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Venus was seen in daylight; Mars transgressed Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Venus was visible in daylight, and Mars transgressed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，太白犯斗宿。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Venus transgressed the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Venus transgressed the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 立中書分省於濟寧。

translations.literal: A branch secretariat was established at Jining.
translations.idiomatic: A branch secretariat was established at Jining.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，歲星犯右執法。

translations.literal: On guisi day, Jupiter transgressed the Right Law Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, Jupiter transgressed the Right Law Administrator.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以宗王神保克復睢寧、虹縣有功，賜金帶一，從征者賞銀有差。

translations.literal: On guimao day, because the imperial prince Shenbao had meritoriously recovered Suining and Hong County, he was granted one gold belt, and those who joined the campaign were rewarded with silver according to distinction.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, because the imperial prince Shenbao had meritoriously recovered Suining and Hong County, he was granted a gold belt, and those who joined the campaign were rewarded with silver according to rank.

sentences.zh: 丙午，熒惑犯左執法。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, Mars transgressed the Left Law Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Mars transgressed the Left Law Administrator.

sentences.zh: 是月，天雨黑子於饒州，大如黍菽。

translations.literal: That month, black seeds rained from the sky at Raozhou, as large as millet and beans.
translations.idiomatic: That month, black seeds as large as millet and beans rained from the sky at Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 徐壽輝據蘄水為都，國號天完，僭稱皇帝，改元治平，以鄒普勝為太師。

translations.literal: Xu Shouhui made Qishui his capital, took the state name Tianwan, arrogated the title of emperor, changed the era name to Taiping, and made Zou Pusheng grand preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shouhui made Qishui his capital, declared the state of Tianwan, arrogated the title of emperor, adopted the era name Taiping, and appointed Zou Pusheng as grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸酉，有星孛於婁宿。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on guiyou day, a broom star appeared at the Bond mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the guiyou day, a comet appeared at the Bond mansion.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，孛星見於胃宿。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, the broom star appeared at the Stomach mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, the comet appeared at the Stomach mansion.

sentences.zh: 乙卯、丙辰，亦如之。

translations.literal: On yimao and bingchen days, it was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao and bingchen days, it was likewise.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，太陰犯填星，孛星微見於畢宿。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, the moon transgressed Saturn; the broom star faintly appeared at the Net mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, the moon transgressed Saturn, and the comet faintly appeared at the Net mansion.

sentences.zh: 黃河堤成，散軍民役夫。

translations.literal: The Yellow River dikes were completed, and soldiers, civilians, and corvée laborers were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River dikes were completed, and the soldiers, civilians, and corvée laborers were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 庚午，監察御史徹徹帖木兒等言，右丞相脫脫治河功成，宜有異數以旌其勞。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, the supervising censor Cheche Temür and others said that Toqto, right chief minister of the Secretariat, had completed the river-control project with success and ought to receive an extraordinary reward to honor his labor.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, Supervising Censor Cheche Temür and others reported that Toqto, right chief minister of the Secretariat, had successfully completed the river-control project and ought to receive an extraordinary reward to honor his service.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，江西妖人鄧南二作亂，攻瑞州，總管禹蘇福擒斬之。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, the sorcerer Deng Nan'er of Jiangxi raised rebellion and attacked Ruizhou; the prefect Yu Sufu captured and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, the sorcerer Deng Nan'er of Jiangxi raised rebellion and attacked Ruizhou. Prefect Yu Sufu captured and executed him.

sentences.zh: 是月，遣使以治河功成告祭河伯，召賈魯還朝。

translations.literal: That month, envoys were dispatched to announce and sacrifice to the River Lord upon the successful completion of river control, and Jia Lu was summoned to return to court.
translations.idiomatic: That month, envoys were dispatched to announce the successful completion of the river-control project and sacrifice to the River Lord, and Jia Lu was summoned to return to court.

sentences.zh: 超授榮祿大夫、集賢大學士，賜金系腰一、銀十錠、鈔千錠、幣帛各二十匹。

translations.literal: He was specially promoted to grand master for glorious blessing and grand academician of the Hall of Worthies, and granted one gold belt, ten ingots of silver, one thousand ingots of notes, and twenty bolts each of silks and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: He was specially promoted to grand master for glorious blessing and grand academician of the Hall of Worthies, and granted a gold belt, ten ingots of silver, one thousand ingots of notes, and twenty bolts each of silks and cloth.

sentences.zh: 都水監並有司官有功者三十七員，皆升遷其職。

translations.literal: Thirty-seven meritorious officials of the Directorate of Waterways and the relevant offices were all promoted in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-seven meritorious officials of the Directorate of Waterways and the relevant offices were all promoted in rank.

sentences.zh: 詔賜脫脫答剌罕之號，俾世襲之，以淮安路為其食邑。

translations.literal: An edict bestowed upon Toqto the title of darughachi, making it hereditary, with Huaian Circuit as his fief.
translations.idiomatic: An edict bestowed upon Toqto the title of darughachi, to be inherited in perpetuity, with Huaian Circuit as his fief.

sentences.zh: 命立《河平碑》。

translations.literal: An order was issued to erect the "River Pacification Stele."
translations.idiomatic: An order was issued to erect the River Pacification Stele.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙子朔，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on the bingzi new moon, Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the bingzi new moon, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，太白經天。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, Venus crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Venus crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 己卯，立河防提舉司，隸行都水監。

translations.literal: On jimao day, a bureau for promoting river defense was established, subordinate to the regional Directorate of Waterways.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, a bureau for promoting river defense was established, subordinate to the regional Directorate of Waterways.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，太白經天，是夜，犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Venus crossed the meridian; that night it transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Venus crossed the meridian; that night it transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太陰犯填星。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, the moon transgressed Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the moon transgressed Saturn.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，太白復經天，是夜，復犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Venus again crossed the meridian; that night it again transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Venus again crossed the meridian; that night it again transgressed the Encampment Wall formation.

sentences.zh: 以治書侍御史烏古孫良楨為中書參知政事。

translations.literal: Wugusun Liangzhen, supervising secretary of the Secretariat, was appointed vice grand councillor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Wugusun Liangzhen, supervising secretary of the Secretariat, was appointed vice grand councillor of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，太白經天，壬辰，復如之。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Venus crossed the meridian; on renchen day, it did so again.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Venus crossed the meridian; on the renchen day, it did so again.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太白晝見，太陰犯熒惑。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Venus was seen in daylight; the moon transgressed Mars.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Venus was visible in daylight, and the moon transgressed Mars.

sentences.zh: 命脫脫於淮安立諸路打捕鷹房民匠錢糧總管府，秩從三品。

translations.literal: Toqto was ordered to establish at Huaian a general office for managing funds and grain for hunting, hawking, and artisan corvée of all circuits, with rank of third grade subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: Toqto was ordered to establish at Huaian a general office for managing funds and grain for hunting, hawking, and artisan corvée of all circuits, with rank of third grade subordinate.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太白經天，辰星犯天江。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Venus crossed the meridian, and Mercury transgressed the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Venus crossed the meridian, and Mercury transgressed the Celestial River.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，太白經天。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, Venus crossed the meridian.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, Venus crossed the meridian.

sentences.zh: 也先帖木兒復上蔡縣，擒韓咬兒等至京師，誅之。

translations.literal: Yesen Temür recovered Shangcai County, captured Han Yao'er and others, brought them to the capital, and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: Yesen Temür recovered Shangcai County, captured Han Yao'er and others, brought them to the capital, and executed them.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 是歲，括馬。

translations.literal: That year, horses were requisitioned.
translations.idiomatic: That year, horses were requisitioned.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月丙午朔，詔印造中統元寶交鈔一百九十萬錠、至元鈔十萬錠。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, spring, first month, on the bingwu new moon, an edict ordered the printing of one million nine hundred thousand ingots of Zhongtong precious treasure exchange notes and one hundred thousand ingots of Zhiyuan notes.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, on the bingwu new moon of the first month of spring, an edict ordered the printing of one million nine hundred thousand ingots of Zhongtong precious treasure exchange notes and one hundred thousand ingots of Zhiyuan notes.

sentences.zh: 戊申，竹山縣賊陷襄陽路，總管柴肅死之。

translations.literal: On wushen day, bandits from Zhushan County captured Xiangyang Circuit; the prefect Chai Su died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, bandits from Zhushan County captured Xiangyang Circuit. Prefect Chai Su died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 是日，荊門州亦陷。

translations.literal: That same day, Jingmen Prefecture also fell.
translations.idiomatic: That same day, Jingmen Prefecture also fell.

sentences.zh: 己酉，時享太廟。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, seasonal offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, seasonal offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以宣政院使月魯不花為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Yue Lubuhua, commissioner of the Court for the Spread of Governance, was appointed chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Yue Lubuhua, commissioner of the Court for the Spread of Governance, was appointed chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 壬子，中書省臣言：「河南、陜西、腹裏諸路，供給繁重，調兵討賊，正當春首耕作之時，恐農民不能安於田畝，守令有失勸課，宜委通曉農事官員，分道巡視，督勒守令，親詣鄉都，省諭農民，依時播種，務要人盡其力，地盡其利。

translations.literal: On renzi day, ministers of the Secretariat reported: "In the circuits of Henan, Shaanxi, and the metropolitan region, the burden of supply is heavy, and troops are being mobilized to suppress bandits just at the start of spring plowing. We fear that farmers cannot remain secure in their fields and that prefects and magistrates may fail in their duty to encourage cultivation. Officials versed in agricultural affairs should be dispatched to tour the circuits separately, to urge and compel prefects and magistrates to go in person to townships and districts, explain matters to the farmers, and sow at the proper season, so that every person exerts his strength and every plot yields its full benefit.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, ministers of the Secretariat reported: "In the circuits of Henan, Shaanxi, and the metropolitan region, the burden of supply is heavy, and troops are being mobilized to suppress bandits just at the start of spring plowing. We fear that farmers cannot remain secure in their fields and that prefects and magistrates may fail in their duty to encourage cultivation. Officials versed in agricultural affairs should be dispatched to tour the circuits separately, to urge and compel prefects and magistrates to go in person to townships and districts, explain matters to the farmers, and sow at the proper season, so that every person exerts his strength and every plot yields its full benefit.

sentences.zh: 其有曾經盜賊、水患、供給之處，貧民不能自備牛、種者，所在有司給之。

translations.literal: In places that have suffered from bandits, flooding, or heavy supply levies, where poor people cannot provide their own oxen and seed, the local offices should supply them.
translations.idiomatic: In places that have suffered from bandits, flooding, or heavy supply levies, where poor people cannot provide their own oxen and seed, the local offices should supply them.

sentences.zh: 仍令總兵官，禁止屯駐軍馬，毋得踏踐，以致農事廢弛。

translations.literal: The overall commanders should also be ordered to forbid garrisoned troops and horses from trampling the fields, lest agricultural work be neglected.
translations.idiomatic: Overall commanders should also be ordered to forbid garrisoned troops and horses from trampling the fields, lest agricultural work be neglected.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，淮東宣慰司添設同知宣慰司事及都事各一員。

translations.literal: On yimao day, one additional associate commissioner for affairs and one secretary were added to the Huaidong Commissioner's Office.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, one additional associate commissioner for affairs and one secretary were added to the Huaidong commissioner's office.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，徐壽輝遣偽將丁普郎、徐明遠陷漢陽。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Xu Shouhui sent his rebel generals Ding Pulang and Xu Mingyuan, who captured Hanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Xu Shouhui sent his rebel generals Ding Pulang and Xu Mingyuan, who captured Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，陷興國府。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Xingguo Prefecture fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Xingguo Prefecture fell.

sentences.zh: 己未，徐壽輝遣鄒普勝陷武昌，威順王寬徹普化、湖廣行省平章政事和尚棄城走。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Xu Shouhui sent Zou Pusheng, who captured Wuchang. Prince of Weishun Kuanchipuhua and Chief Minister of the Huguang Branch Secretariat Heshang abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Xu Shouhui sent Zou Pusheng, who captured Wuchang. Prince of Weishun Kuanchipuhua and Chief Minister of the Huguang branch secretariat Heshang abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 刑部尚書阿魯收捕山東賊，給敕牒十一道，使分賞有功者。

translations.literal: Aru, minister of the Ministry of Justice, was sent to suppress bandits in Shandong and given eleven commissions to bestow on those who had merit.
translations.idiomatic: Aru, minister of the Ministry of Justice, was sent to suppress bandits in Shandong and given eleven commissions to bestow on those who had merit.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，徐壽輝偽將魯法興陷安陸府，知府醜驢戰不勝，死之。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, Xu Shouhui's rebel general Lu Faxing captured Anlu Prefecture; the prefect Choulü fought but could not prevail and died.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Xu Shouhui's rebel general Lu Faxing captured Anlu Prefecture. Prefect Choulü fought but could not prevail and died.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，刑部添設尚書、侍郎、郎中、員外郎各一員，五愛馬添設忽剌罕赤一百名。

translations.literal: On guihai day, one additional minister, vice minister, director, and vice director were added to the Ministry of Justice; at Wu'aima, one hundred hulaguchi were added.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, one additional minister, vice minister, director, and vice director were added to the Ministry of Justice; at Wu'aima, one hundred hulaguchi were added.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，太陰犯熒惑。

translations.literal: On yichou day, the moon transgressed Mars.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, the moon transgressed Mars.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以河復故道，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, because the river had returned to its old course, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, because the river had returned to its old course, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 己巳，歲星犯右執法。
