translations.literal: On jisi day, Jupiter transgressed the Right Lawgiver.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, Jupiter transgressed the Right Lawgiver.

sentences.zh: 辛未，徐壽輝兵陷沔陽府。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Xu Shouhui's forces captured Mianyang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Xu Shouhui's forces captured Mianyang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬申，中興路陷，山南宣慰司同知月古輪失領兵出戰，眾潰，宣慰使錦州不花、山南廉訪使卜禮月敦皆遁走。

translations.literal: On renshen day, Zhongxing Circuit fell. Yue Guluenshi, associate commissioner of the Shannan Commissioner's Office, led troops out to battle, but the army was routed. Commissioner Jinzhoubuhua and Shannan Surveillance Commissioner Boleymudun all fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Zhongxing Circuit fell. Yue Guluenshi, associate commissioner of the Shannan commissioner's office, led troops out to battle, but the army was routed. Commissioner Jinzhoubuhua and Shannan surveillance commissioner Boleymudun all fled.

sentences.zh: 是月，命逯魯曾為淮東添設元帥，統領兩淮所募鹽丁五千討徐州。

translations.literal: That month, Lu Luceng was appointed additional marshal of Huaidong and ordered to lead five thousand salt laborers recruited from the two Huai regions to campaign against Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Lu Luceng was appointed additional marshal of Huaidong and ordered to lead five thousand salt laborers recruited from the two Huai regions to campaign against Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 拘刷河南、陜西、遼陽三省及上都、大都、腹裏等處漢人馬。

translations.literal: Horses belonging to Han people were requisitioned in the three provinces of Henan, Shaanxi, and Liaoyang and in Shangdu, Dadu, the metropolitan region, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Horses belonging to Han people were requisitioned in the three provinces of Henan, Shaanxi, and Liaoyang and in Shangdu, Dadu, the metropolitan region, and other places.

sentences.zh: 命四川行省平章政事月魯帖木兒為總兵官，與四川行省右丞長吉討興元、金州等處賊；

translations.literal: Yue Lutuemuer, chief minister of the Sichuan branch secretariat, was appointed overall commander and, together with Changji, right vice director of the Sichuan branch secretariat, ordered to campaign against bandits in Xingyuan, Jinzhou, and other places;
translations.idiomatic: Yue Lutuemuer, chief minister of the Sichuan branch secretariat, was appointed overall commander and, together with Changji, right vice director of the Sichuan branch secretariat, ordered to campaign against bandits in Xingyuan, Jinzhou, and other places;

sentences.zh: 宣政院同知桑哥率領亦都護畏吾兒軍與荊湖北道宣慰使朵兒只班同守襄陽；

translations.literal: Sangge, associate commissioner of the Court for the Spread of Governance, was to lead the Uyghur troops of Yidu Guard together with Du'erzhiban, commissioner of the North Hubei Circuit Commissioner's Office, to jointly defend Xiangyang;
translations.idiomatic: Sangge, associate commissioner of the Court for the Spread of Governance, was to lead the Uyghur troops of Yidu Guard together with Du'erzhiban, commissioner of the North Hubei circuit commissioner's office, to jointly defend Xiangyang;

sentences.zh: 濟寧兵馬指揮使寶童統領右都衛軍，從知樞密院事月闊察兒討徐州。

translations.literal: Baotong, commander of Jining Military and Horse Affairs, was to lead the Right Capital Guard Army and follow Yuekuochae'r, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, in campaigning against Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Baotong, commander of Jining military and horse affairs, was to lead the Right Capital Guard Army and follow Yuekuochae'r, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, in campaigning against Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥朔，詔許溪洞蠻猺自新。

translations.literal: Second month, on the yihai new moon, an edict permitted the Miao and Yao of the stream-cave districts to submit and reform.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the yihai new moon, an edict permitted the Miao and Yao of the stream-cave districts to submit and reform.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以集賢大學士賈魯為中書添設左丞；

translations.literal: On dingchou day, Jia Lu, grand academician of the Hall of Worthies, was appointed additional left vice director of the Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Jia Lu, grand academician of the Hall of Worthies, was appointed additional left vice director of the Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 以河南廉訪使哈藍朵兒只為荊湖北道宣慰使都元帥，守襄陽。

translations.literal: Qarandorji, surveillance commissioner of Henan, was appointed marshal-in-chief and commissioner of the North Hubei Circuit Commissioner's Office to defend Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Qarandorji, surveillance commissioner of Henan, was appointed marshal-in-chief and commissioner of the North Hubei circuit commissioner's office to defend Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命諸王禿堅領從官百人，馳驛守揚州，賜金一錠、鈔一千錠。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, Prince Tujian was ordered to lead a hundred attendants by post-horse relay to defend Yangzhou and was granted one ingot of gold and one thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Prince Tujian was ordered to lead a hundred attendants by post-horse relay to defend Yangzhou and was granted one ingot of gold and one thousand ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 命西寧王牙安沙鎮四川。

translations.literal: Prince of Xining Yansha was ordered to garrison Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Xining Yansha was ordered to garrison Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 賜鎮南王孛羅不花鈔一萬錠。

translations.literal: Prince of Zhennan Boluobuqa was granted ten thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Zhennan Boluobuqa was granted ten thousand ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 甲申，鄒平縣馬子昭為亂，捕斬之。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, Ma Zizhao raised rebellion in Zouping County; he was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, Ma Zizhao raised rebellion in Zouping County. He was captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，徐壽輝兵陷江州，總管李黼死之，遂陷南康路。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Xu Shouhui's forces captured Jiangzhou; the prefect Li Fu died in the fighting, and the army then captured Nankang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Xu Shouhui's forces captured Jiangzhou. Prefect Li Fu died in the fighting, and the army then captured Nankang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，霍州靈石縣地震。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Lingshi County in Huozhou was struck by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Lingshi County in Huozhou was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 徐壽輝兵陷岳州，房州賊陷歸州。

translations.literal: Xu Shouhui's forces captured Yuezhou; bandits from Fangzhou captured Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shouhui's forces captured Yuezhou; bandits from Fangzhou captured Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔：「徐州內外群聚之眾，限二十日，不分首從，並與赦原。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, an edict stated: "The assembled masses inside and outside Xuzhou, within twenty days and without distinction between leaders and followers, shall all be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, an edict stated: "The assembled masses inside and outside Xuzhou, within twenty days and without distinction between leaders and followers, shall all be pardoned.

sentences.zh: 」置安東、安豐分元帥府。

translations.literal: Sub-marshalates of Andong and Anfeng were established.
translations.idiomatic: Sub-marshalates of Andong and Anfeng were established.

sentences.zh: 己丑，遊皇城。

translations.literal: On jichou day, the emperor toured the Imperial City.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, the emperor toured the Imperial City.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，太陰犯太微垣。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，太陰犯氐宿。

translations.literal: On guisi day, the moon transgressed the Di mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, the moon transgressed the Di mansion.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，鄧州賊王權、張椿陷澧州，龍鎮衛指揮使俺都剌哈蠻等帥師復之。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, the bandits Wang Quan and Zhang Chun of Dengzhou captured Lizhou; Andulahaman, commander of Longzhen Guard, and others led troops and recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the bandits Wang Quan and Zhang Chun of Dengzhou captured Lizhou. Andulahaman, commander of Longzhen Guard, and others led troops and recovered it.

sentences.zh: 褒贈伏節死義宣徽使帖木兒等二十七人。

translations.literal: Posthumous honors were bestowed upon twenty-seven men who held fast to their integrity and died for righteousness, including Commissioner of the Court of Imperial Attendants Temür.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous honors were bestowed upon twenty-seven men who held fast to their integrity and died for righteousness, including Commissioner of the Court of Imperial Attendants Temür.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以御史大夫納麟為江南行臺御史大夫，仍太尉。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Nalin, censor-in-chief, was appointed censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate while retaining his post as grand marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Nalin, censor-in-chief, was appointed censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan branch censorate while retaining his post as grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 命翰林學士承旨八剌與諸王孛蘭奚領軍守大名。

translations.literal: Bal, academician exhorter-in-chief of the Hanlin Academy, and Prince Bolanxi were ordered to lead troops to defend Daming.
translations.idiomatic: Bal, academician exhorter-in-chief of the Hanlin Academy, and Prince Bolanxi were ordered to lead troops to defend Daming.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命中書平章政事月魯不花知經筵事，左丞賈魯、參知政事帖理帖木兒、烏古孫良楨並同知經筵事。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Yue Lubuhua, chief minister of the Secretariat, was appointed director of the Classics Colloquium; Left Vice Director Jia Lu and Vice Grand Councillors Tili Temür and Wugusun Liangzhen were all appointed associate directors of the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Yue Lubuhua, chief minister of the Secretariat, was appointed director of the Classics Colloquium; Left Vice Director Jia Lu and Vice Grand Councillors Tili Temür and Wugusun Liangzhen were all appointed associate directors of the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 是月，賊侵滑、浚，命德住為河南右丞，守東明。

translations.literal: That month, bandits invaded Hua and Jun; Dezhu was appointed right vice director of Henan to defend Dongming.
translations.idiomatic: That month, bandits invaded Hua and Jun. Dezhu was appointed right vice director of Henan to defend Dongming.

sentences.zh: 德住時致仕於家，聞命，馳至東明，浚城隍，嚴備禦，賊不敢犯。

translations.literal: Dezhu was then retired at home; upon hearing the order, he hastened to Dongming, dredged the moat and city walls, and made strict preparations for defense, so that the bandits did not dare attack.
translations.idiomatic: Dezhu was then retired at home. Upon hearing the order, he hastened to Dongming, dredged the moat and city walls, and made strict preparations for defense, so that the bandits did not dare attack.

sentences.zh: 徐壽輝偽將歐普祥陷袁州。

translations.literal: Xu Shouhui's rebel general Ou Puxiang captured Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shouhui's rebel general Ou Puxiang captured Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 命帖理帖木兒以中書參知政事分省濟寧。

translations.literal: Tili Temür was ordered to serve as vice grand councillor of the Secretariat with branch secretariat authority at Jining.
translations.idiomatic: Tili Temür was ordered to serve as vice grand councillor of the Secretariat with branch secretariat authority at Jining.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳朔，追封太師、忠王馬紥兒臺為德王。

translations.literal: Third month, on the yisi new moon, Grand Preceptor and Prince of Loyalty Mazhertai was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the yisi new moon, Grand Preceptor and Prince of Loyalty Mazhertai was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Virtue.

sentences.zh: 丁未，徐壽輝偽將許甲攻衡州，洞官黃安撫敗之。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, Xu Shouhui's rebel general Xu Jia attacked Hengzhou; the cave official Huang Anfu defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, Xu Shouhui's rebel general Xu Jia attacked Hengzhou. The cave official Huang Anfu defeated him.

sentences.zh: 徐壽輝偽將陶九陷瑞州，總管禹蘇福、萬戶張嶽敗之。

translations.literal: Xu Shouhui's rebel general Tao Jiu captured Ruizhou; the prefect Yu Sufu and centurion Zhang Yue defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shouhui's rebel general Tao Jiu captured Ruizhou. Prefect Yu Sufu and Centurion Zhang Yue defeated him.

sentences.zh: 壬子，河南左丞相太不花克復南陽等處。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Taiduhua, left chief minister of Henan, recovered Nanyang and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Taiduhua, left chief minister of Henan, recovered Nanyang and other places.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，中書省臣請行納粟補官之令：「凡各處士庶，果能為國宣力，自備糧米供給軍儲者，照依定擬地方實授常選流官，依例升轉、封蔭；

translations.literal: On guichou day, ministers of the Secretariat requested implementation of the order for grain purchase to obtain office: "Wherever commoners and gentry can truly serve the state by their own efforts and provide grain and rice from their own resources to supply military stores, they shall receive regular selected civil appointments in the designated locality according to the fixed regulations, with promotion and enfeoffment of descendants as prescribed;
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, ministers of the Secretariat requested implementation of the order for grain purchase to obtain office: "Wherever commoners and gentry can truly serve the state by their own efforts and provide grain and rice from their own resources to supply military stores, they shall receive regular selected civil appointments in the designated locality according to the fixed regulations, with promotion and enfeoffment of descendants as prescribed;

sentences.zh: 及已除茶鹽錢谷官有能再備錢糧供給軍儲者，驗見授品級，改授常流。

translations.literal: and those already appointed as tea, salt, and revenue officials who can again provide funds and grain to supply military stores shall, upon verification of their current rank, be transferred to regular civil appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Those already appointed as tea, salt, and revenue officials who can again provide funds and grain to supply military stores shall, upon verification of their current rank, be transferred to regular civil appointments.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 戊午，太陰犯進賢。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, the moon transgressed the Worthy.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, the moon transgressed the Worthy.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，命親王阿兒麻以兵討商州等處賊。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, Prince Arima was ordered to campaign with troops against bandits in Shangzhou and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Prince Arima was ordered to campaign with troops against bandits in Shangzhou and other places.

sentences.zh: 以鞏卜班知行樞密院事。

translations.literal: Gongbuban was appointed acting director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Gongbuban was appointed acting director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太陰犯東咸。

translations.literal: On renxu day, the moon transgressed the Eastern Rampart.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, the moon transgressed the Eastern Rampart.

sentences.zh: 甲子，徐壽輝偽將項普略陷饒州路，遂陷徽州、信州。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, Xu Shouhui's rebel general Xiang Pulu captured Raozhou Circuit and then captured Huizhou and Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Xu Shouhui's rebel general Xiang Pulu captured Raozhou Circuit and then captured Huizhou and Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 四川未附生蠻向亞甲洞主墨得什用出降，立盤順府。

translations.literal: Modeshiyong, chieftain of the unsubmitting raw barbarians of Xiangyajia Cave in Sichuan, surrendered; Panshun Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: Modeshiyong, chieftain of the unsubmitting raw barbarians of Xiangyajia Cave in Sichuan, surrendered, and Panshun Prefecture was established.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，江南行臺御史大夫帖木哥乞致仕，不允，以為甘肅行省平章政事。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, Temüge, censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate, requested retirement; the request was not granted, and he was appointed chief minister of the Gansu branch secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, Temüge, censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan branch censorate, requested retirement. The request was not granted, and he was appointed chief minister of the Gansu branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 以出征馬少，出幣帛各一十萬匹，於迤北萬戶、千戶所易馬。

translations.literal: Because horses for the expedition were few, one hundred thousand bolts each of silks and cloth were issued to exchange for horses at the myriarchies and chiliarchies of the far north.
translations.idiomatic: Because horses for the expedition were few, one hundred thousand bolts each of silks and cloth were issued to exchange for horses at the myriarchies and chiliarchies of the far north.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 詔：「南人有才學者，依世祖舊制，中書省、樞密院、御史臺皆用之。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Talented and learned men of the south, according to the former institutions of Kublai, shall be employed in the Secretariat, Bureau of Military Affairs, and Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Talented and learned men of the south, according to the former institutions of Kublai, shall be employed in the Secretariat, Bureau of Military Affairs, and Censorate.

sentences.zh: 」中書省臣言：「張理獻言，饒州德興三處，膽水浸鐵，可以成銅，宜即其地各立銅冶場，直隸寶泉提舉司，宜以張理就為銅冶場官。

translations.literal: Ministers of the Secretariat reported: "Zhang Li submitted a proposal that at three places in Raozhou and Dexing, iron soaked in bile water can be converted into copper. Copper smelting offices should be established on the spot in each place, directly subordinate to the Treasured Spring Directorate, and Zhang Li should be appointed smelting officer."
translations.idiomatic: Ministers of the Secretariat reported: "Zhang Li submitted a proposal that at three places in Raozhou and Dexing, iron soaked in bile water can be converted into copper. Copper smelting offices should be established on the spot in each place, directly subordinate to the Treasured Spring directorate, and Zhang Li should be appointed smelting officer."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 以江浙行省左丞相亦憐真班為江西行省左丞相，領兵收捕饒、信賊。

translations.literal: Yilianzhenban, left chief minister of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, was appointed left chief minister of the Jiangxi branch secretariat and ordered to lead troops to suppress bandits in Raozhou and Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yilianzhenban, left chief minister of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, was appointed left chief minister of the Jiangxi branch secretariat and ordered to lead troops to suppress bandits in Raozhou and Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔：「隨朝一品職事及省、臺、院、六部、翰林、集賢、司農、太常、宣政、宣徽、中政、資正、國子、秘書、崇文、都水諸正官，各舉循良材幹、智勇兼全、堪充守令者二人。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, an edict stated: "Officials of first rank at court and the chief officials of the secretariat, censorate, privy council, six ministries, Hanlin, Hall of Worthies, Ministry of Revenue, Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Court for the Spread of Governance, Court of Imperial Attendants, Court of Central Governance, Bureau of Excellent Governance, Directorate of Education, Directorate of Archives, Directorate of Belles-Lettres, and Directorate of Waterways shall each recommend two men of upright character and ability, combining wisdom and courage, fit to serve as prefects and magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, an edict stated: "Officials of first rank at court and the chief officials of the secretariat, censorate, privy council, six ministries, Hanlin, Hall of Worthies, Ministry of Revenue, Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Court for the Spread of Governance, Court of Imperial Attendants, Court of Central Governance, Bureau of Excellent Governance, Directorate of Education, Directorate of Archives, Directorate of Belles-Lettres, and Directorate of Waterways shall each recommend two men of upright character and ability, combining wisdom and courage, fit to serve as prefects and magistrates.

sentences.zh: 知人多者，不限員數。

translations.literal: Those who know more men need not be limited in number.
translations.idiomatic: Those who know more men need not be limited in number.

sentences.zh: 各處試用守令，並授兼管義兵防禦諸軍奧魯勸農事，所在上司不許擅差。

translations.literal: Trial prefects and magistrates appointed in each place shall also be granted concurrent charge of righteous armies, defense of all military households and garrisons, and encouragement of agriculture, and their superiors may not reassign them at will.
translations.idiomatic: Trial prefects and magistrates appointed in each place shall also be granted concurrent charge of righteous armies, defense of all military households and garrisons, and encouragement of agriculture, and their superiors may not reassign them at will.

sentences.zh: 守令既已優升，其佐貳官員，比依入廣例，量升二等。

translations.literal: Since the prefects and magistrates have already been promoted by special favor, their deputy officials shall, following the precedent for entering Guangdong, be promoted two grades in rank as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Since the prefects and magistrates have already been promoted by special favor, their deputy officials shall, following the precedent for entering Guangdong, be promoted two grades in rank as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 任滿，驗守令全治者，與真授；

translations.literal: At the end of their terms, those whose prefects and magistrates have fully governed well shall receive regular appointments;
translations.idiomatic: At the end of their terms, those whose prefects and magistrates have fully governed well shall receive regular appointments;

sentences.zh: 不治者，全削二等，依本等敘；

translations.literal: those who have not governed well shall be reduced two full grades and ranked according to their original grade;
translations.idiomatic: those who have not governed well shall be reduced two full grades and ranked according to their original grade;

sentences.zh: 半治者，減一等敘。

translations.literal: those who have half governed well shall be ranked one grade lower.
translations.idiomatic: those who have half governed well shall be ranked one grade lower.

sentences.zh: 雜職人員，其有知勇之士，並依上例。

translations.literal: Among miscellaneous officials, any men of wisdom and courage shall likewise follow the above precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Among miscellaneous officials, any men of wisdom and courage shall likewise follow the above precedent.

sentences.zh: 凡除常選官於殘破郡縣及迫近賊境之處，升四等；

translations.literal: Whenever regular selected officials are appointed to ravaged prefectures and counties or to places near bandit territory, they shall be promoted four grades;
translations.idiomatic: Whenever regular selected officials are appointed to ravaged prefectures and counties or to places near bandit territory, they shall be promoted four grades;

sentences.zh: 稍近賊境，升二等。

translations.literal: to places somewhat nearer bandit territory, two grades.
translations.idiomatic: to places somewhat nearer bandit territory, two grades.

sentences.zh: 」是月，方國珍復劫其黨下海，入黃巖港，臺州路達魯花赤泰不花率官軍與戰，死之。

translations.literal: That month, Fang Guozhen again incited his followers to take to the sea, entered Huangyan Harbor, and Taibuha, darughachi of Taizhou Route, led government troops to fight them and died.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Fang Guozhen again incited his followers to take to the sea and entered Huangyan Harbor. Taibuha, darughachi of Taizhou Route, led government troops to fight them and died.

sentences.zh: 隴西地震百餘日，城郭頹夷，陵谷遷變，定西、會州、靜寧、莊浪尤甚。

translations.literal: Longxi was shaken by earthquakes for more than a hundred days; city walls collapsed, hills and valleys shifted, and Dingxi, Huichou, Jingning, and Zhuanglang suffered most severely.
translations.idiomatic: Longxi was shaken by earthquakes for more than a hundred days. City walls collapsed, hills and valleys shifted, and Dingxi, Huichou, Jingning, and Zhuanglang suffered most severely.

sentences.zh: 會州公宇中墻崩，獲弩五百餘張，長者丈餘，短者九尺，人莫能挽。

translations.literal: In the government compound at Huichou, a wall collapsed and more than five hundred crossbows were recovered; the long ones measured more than a zhang, the short ones nine chi, and no man could draw them.
translations.idiomatic: In the government compound at Huichou, a wall collapsed and more than five hundred crossbows were recovered. The long ones measured more than a zhang, the short ones nine chi, and no man could draw them.

sentences.zh: 改定西為安定州，會州為會寧州。

translations.literal: Dingxi was redesignated Anding Prefecture, and Huichou was redesignated Huining Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Dingxi was redesignated Anding Prefecture, and Huichou was redesignated Huining Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔定軍民官不守城池之罪。

translations.literal: An edict fixed the penalties for military and civilian officials who failed to hold their cities and strongholds.
translations.idiomatic: An edict fixed the penalties for military and civilian officials who failed to hold their cities and strongholds.

sentences.zh: 閏三月辛巳，以臺州路達魯花赤泰不花為江浙行省參知政事，行臺州路事，命下，泰不花已死。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, on xinsi day, Taibuha, darughachi of Taizhou Route, was appointed vice grand councillor of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat to administer Taizhou Route affairs; when the order was issued, Taibuha was already dead.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary third month, on the xinsi day, Taibuha, darughachi of Taizhou Route, was appointed vice grand councillor of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat to administer Taizhou Route affairs. When the order was issued, Taibuha was already dead.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以大理宣慰使答失八都魯為四川行省添設參知政事，與本省平章政事咬住討山南、湖廣等處賊。

translations.literal: On renwu day, Dashibadoulu, pacification commissioner of Dali, was appointed additional vice grand councillor of the Sichuan branch secretariat and, together with chief minister Qiaozhu of that province, was ordered to campaign against bandits in Shannan, Huguang, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, Dashibadoulu, pacification commissioner of Dali, was appointed additional vice grand councillor of the Sichuan branch secretariat and, together with Chief Minister Qiaozhu of that province, was ordered to campaign against bandits in Shannan, Huguang, and other places.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，徐壽輝偽將陳普文陷吉安路，鄉民羅明遠起義兵復之。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Chen Puwen, rebel general of Xu Shouhui, captured Ji'an Route; the local man Luo Mingyuan raised a righteous army and recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Chen Puwen, rebel general of Xu Shouhui, captured Ji'an Route. The local man Luo Mingyuan raised a righteous army and recovered it.

sentences.zh: 命工部尚書朵來、兵部侍郎馬某火者，分詣上都、察罕腦兒、集寧等處，給散出征河南達達軍口糧。

translations.literal: Duolai, minister of works, and Ma Mouhuozhe, vice minister of war, were ordered to go separately to Shangdu, Chaghan Na'ur, Jining, and other places to distribute rations to the Dada troops of Henan on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Duolai, minister of works, and Ma Mouhuozhe, vice minister of war, were ordered to go separately to Shangdu, Chaghan Na'ur, Jining, and other places to distribute rations to the Dada troops of Henan on campaign.

sentences.zh: 立淮南江北等處行中書省，治揚州，轄揚州、高郵、淮安、滁州、和州、廬州、安豐、安慶、蘄州、黃州。

translations.literal: The Huainan and Jiangbei Branch Secretariat was established, with its seat at Yangzhou, governing Yangzhou, Gaoyou, Huai'an, Chuzhou, Hezhou, Luzhou, Anfeng, Anqing, Qizhou, and Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Huainan and Jiangbei branch secretariat was established, with its seat at Yangzhou, governing Yangzhou, Gaoyou, Huai'an, Chuzhou, Hezhou, Luzhou, Anfeng, Anqing, Qizhou, and Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以大都留守兀忽失為江浙行省添設右丞，討饒、信賊。

translations.literal: On renchen day, Wu Hushi, chief steward of the capital, was appointed additional right vice director of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat and ordered to campaign against bandits in Raozhou and Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Wu Hushi, chief steward of the capital, was appointed additional right vice director of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat and ordered to campaign against bandits in Raozhou and Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，阿速愛馬裏納忽臺擒滑州、開州賊韓兀奴罕有功，授資用庫大使。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Nahuotai of the Asud horse guard captured Han Wunuhan, bandit leader of Huazhou and Kaizhou, with merit, and was appointed commissioner of the Treasury of Supplies.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Nahuotai of the Asud horse guard captured Han Wunuhan, bandit leader of Huazhou and Kaizhou, with merit and was appointed commissioner of the Treasury of Supplies.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，湖廣行省參知政事鐵傑，以湖南兵復岳州。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Tie Jie, vice grand councillor of the Huguang branch secretariat, recovered Yuezhou with Hunan troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Tie Jie, vice grand councillor of the Huguang branch secretariat, recovered Yuezhou with Hunan troops.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔淮南行省設官二十五員，以翰林學士承旨晃火兒不花、湖廣平章政事失列門並為平章政事，淮東元帥蠻子為右丞，燕南廉訪使秦從德為左丞，陜西行臺侍御史答失禿、山北廉訪使趙璉並為參知政事。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, an edict established twenty-five posts for the Huainan branch secretariat: Huanghuo'erbuhua, academician exhorter-in-chief, and Shiliemen, chief minister of Huguang, were both made chief ministers; Manzi, marshal of eastern Huai, was made right vice director; Qin Congde, surveillance commissioner of Yannan, was made left vice director; Dashitu, attendant censor of the Shaanxi branch censorate, and Zhao Lian, surveillance commissioner of Shanbei, were both made vice grand councillors.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, an edict established twenty-five posts for the Huainan branch secretariat. Huanghuo'erbuhua, academician exhorter-in-chief, and Shiliemen, chief minister of Huguang, were both made chief ministers; Manzi, marshal of eastern Huai, was made right vice director; Qin Congde, surveillance commissioner of Yannan, was made left vice director; Dashitu, attendant censor of the Shaanxi branch censorate, and Zhao Lian, surveillance commissioner of Shanbei, were both made vice grand councillors.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以樞密副使悟良哈臺為中書添設參知政事、同知經筵事。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Wulianghatai, vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed additional vice grand councillor of the Secretariat and associate director of the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Wulianghatai, vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed additional vice grand councillor of the Secretariat and associate director of the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命淮南行省平章政事晃火兒不花提調鎮南王傅事。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, Huanghuo'erbuhua, chief minister of the Huainan branch secretariat, was ordered to take charge of the affairs of the tutor to the Prince of Zhennan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, Huanghuo'erbuhua, chief minister of the Huainan branch secretariat, was ordered to take charge of the affairs of the tutor to the Prince of Zhennan.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔四川行省平章政事咬住以兵東討荊襄賊，克復忠、萬、夔、雲陽等州；

translations.literal: That month, an edict ordered Qiaozhu, chief minister of the Sichuan branch secretariat, to lead troops east to campaign against bandits in Jingxiang and recovered Zhong, Wan, Kui, and Yunyang and other prefectures;
translations.idiomatic: That month, an edict ordered Qiaozhu, chief minister of the Sichuan branch secretariat, to lead troops east to campaign against bandits in Jingxiang and recovered Zhong, Wan, Kui, Yunyang, and other prefectures;

sentences.zh: 命江西行省左丞相亦憐真班以兵守江東、西關隘；

translations.literal: Yilianzhenban, left chief minister of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, was ordered to hold the passes east and west of the Yangzi with troops;
translations.idiomatic: Yilianzhenban, left chief minister of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, was ordered to hold the passes east and west of the Yangzi with troops;

sentences.zh: 命諸王亦憐真班、愛因班，參知政事也先帖木兒與陜西行省平章政事月魯帖木兒討南陽、襄陽賊，刑部尚書阿魯討海寧賊，江西行省右丞火你赤與參知政事朵<角┦>討江西賊；

translations.literal: Princes Yilianzhenban and Aiyinban, Vice Grand Councillor Yesun Temür, and Yue Lute Temür, chief minister of the Shaanxi branch secretariat, were ordered to campaign against bandits in Nanyang and Xiangyang; Aru, minister of justice, was ordered to campaign against bandits in Haining; Huonichi, right vice director of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, and Duo'er, vice grand councillor, were ordered to campaign against bandits in Jiangxi;
translations.idiomatic: Princes Yilianzhenban and Aiyinban, Vice Grand Councillor Yesun Temür, and Yue Lute Temür, chief minister of the Shaanxi branch secretariat, were ordered to campaign against bandits in Nanyang and Xiangyang; Aru, minister of justice, was ordered to campaign against bandits in Haining; Huonichi, right vice director of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, and Duo'er, vice grand councillor, were ordered to campaign against bandits in Jiangxi;

sentences.zh: 以浙東宣慰使恩寧普代江浙行省左丞左答納失裏守蕪湖。

translations.literal: Enningpu, pacification commissioner of eastern Zhejiang, was appointed to replace Zuodanashili, left vice director of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, in defending Wuhu.
translations.idiomatic: Enningpu, pacification commissioner of eastern Zhejiang, was appointed to replace Zuodanashili, left vice director of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, in defending Wuhu.

sentences.zh: 命江西行省右丞兀忽失、江浙行省左丞老老與星吉、不顏帖木兒、蠻子海牙同討饒、信等處賊。

translations.literal: Wu Hushi, right vice director of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, Laolao, left vice director of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, Xingji, Buyan Temür, and Manzi Haiya were ordered together to campaign against bandits in Raozhou, Xinzhou, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Hushi, right vice director of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, Laolao, left vice director of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, Xingji, Buyan Temür, and Manzi Haiya were ordered together to campaign against bandits in Raozhou, Xinzhou, and other places.

sentences.zh: 方國珍不受招安之命，命江浙左丞左答納失裏討之。

translations.literal: Fang Guozhen did not accept the order to submit; Zuodanashili, left vice director of Jiangzhe, was ordered to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Guozhen did not accept the order to submit. Zuodanashili, left vice director of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, was ordered to campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 命典瑞院給淮南行省銀字圓牌三面、驛券五十道。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Seals was ordered to grant the Huainan branch secretariat three round silver-letter tally plaques and fifty courier vouchers.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Seals was ordered to grant the Huainan branch secretariat three round silver-letter tally plaques and fifty courier vouchers.

sentences.zh: 詔江西行省左丞相亦憐真班、淮南行省平章政事晃火兒不花、江浙行省左丞左答納失裏、湖廣行省平章政事也先帖木兒、四川行省平章政事八失忽都及江南行臺御史大夫納麟與江浙行省官，並以便宜行事。

translations.literal: An edict granted Yilianzhenban, left chief minister of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, Huanghuo'erbuhua, chief minister of the Huainan branch secretariat, Zuodanashili, left vice director of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, Yesun Temür, chief minister of the Huguang branch secretariat, Bashihudu, chief minister of the Sichuan branch secretariat, and Nalin, censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan branch censorate, together with officials of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, full discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted Yilianzhenban, left chief minister of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, Huanghuo'erbuhua, chief minister of the Huainan branch secretariat, Zuodanashili, left vice director of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, Yesun Temür, chief minister of the Huguang branch secretariat, Bashihudu, chief minister of the Sichuan branch secretariat, and Nalin, censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan branch censorate, together with officials of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, full discretionary authority.

sentences.zh: 也先帖木兒駐軍沙河，軍中夜驚，軍潰，退屯朱仙鎮。

translations.literal: Yesun Temür encamped at Shahe; the army was alarmed in the night, the troops broke, and he withdrew to encamp at Zhuxian Town.
translations.idiomatic: Yesun Temür encamped at Shahe. The army was alarmed in the night, the troops broke, and he withdrew to encamp at Zhuxian Town.

sentences.zh: 詔以中書平章政事蠻子代總其兵，也先帖木兒還京師，仍命為御史大夫。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Manzi, chief minister of the Secretariat, to take overall command of the army in his stead; Yesun Temür returned to the capital and was still appointed censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Manzi, chief minister of the Secretariat, to take overall command of the army in his stead. Yesun Temür returned to the capital and was still appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, on the guimao new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the guimao new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 江西臨川賊鄧忠陷建昌路。

translations.literal: Deng Zhong, bandit of Linchuan in Jiangxi, captured Jianchang Route.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Zhong, a bandit of Linchuan in Jiangxi, captured Jianchang Route.

sentences.zh: 己酉，時享太廟。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, seasonal offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, seasonal offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以御史大夫搠思監為中書平章政事，提調留守司。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Suosijian, censor-in-chief, was appointed chief minister of the Secretariat and ordered to take charge of the Chief Steward's Office.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Suosijian, censor-in-chief, was appointed chief minister of the Secretariat and ordered to take charge of the chief steward's office.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，鐵傑及萬戶陶夢楨復武昌、漢陽，尋再陷。

translations.literal: On yimao day, Tie Jie and Centurion Tao Mengzhen recovered Wuchang and Hanyang, but they were soon lost again.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Tie Jie and Centurion Tao Mengzhen recovered Wuchang and Hanyang, but they were soon lost again.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，江西宜黃賊塗佑與邵武建寧賊應必達等攻陷邵武路，總管吳按攤不花以兵討之，千戶魏淳以計擒塗佑、應必達，復其城。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Tu You, bandit of Yihuang in Jiangxi, and Ying Bida and others, bandits of Shaowu and Jianning, attacked and captured Shaowu Route; Prefect Wu An'tanbuhua led troops to campaign against them, and Centurion Wei Chun by stratagem captured Tu You and Ying Bida and recovered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Tu You, a bandit of Yihuang in Jiangxi, and Ying Bida and others, bandits of Shaowu and Jianning, attacked and captured Shaowu Route. Prefect Wu An'tanbuhua led troops to campaign against them, and Centurion Wei Chun by stratagem captured Tu You and Ying Bida and recovered the city.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，翰林學士承旨渾都海牙乞致仕，不允，以為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, Hunduhaiya, academician exhorter-in-chief, requested retirement; the request was not granted, and he was appointed chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Hunduhaiya, academician exhorter-in-chief, requested retirement. The request was not granted, and he was appointed chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 四川行省參知政事桑哥失裏復渠州。

translations.literal: Sanggeshili, vice grand councillor of the Sichuan branch secretariat, recovered Quzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sanggeshili, vice grand councillor of the Sichuan branch secretariat, recovered Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，翰林學士承旨歐陽玄以湖廣行省右丞致仕，賜玉帶及鈔一百錠，給全俸終其身。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, Ouyang Xuan, academician exhorter-in-chief, retired as right vice director of the Huguang branch secretariat and was granted a jade belt and one hundred ingots of notes, with full salary for life.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Ouyang Xuan, academician exhorter-in-chief, retired as right vice director of the Huguang branch secretariat and was granted a jade belt and one hundred ingots of notes, with full salary for life.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，諸王禿堅帖木兒、平章政事也先帖木兒討和州有功，各賜金系腰並鈔一千錠。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, Prince Tujian Temür and Chief Minister Yesun Temür, for merit in campaigning against bandits in Hezhou, were each granted a golden girdle and one thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, Prince Tujian Temür and Chief Minister Yesun Temür, for merit in campaigning against bandits in Hezhou, were each granted a golden girdle and one thousand ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 辛未，荊門知州聶炳復荊門州。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Nie Bing, prefect of Jingmen, recovered Jingmen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Nie Bing, prefect of Jingmen, recovered Jingmen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 平章政事忽都海牙年老有疾，詔免其朝賀。

translations.literal: Chief Minister Hudu Haiya was old and ill; an edict exempted him from court audiences.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Minister Hudu Haiya was old and ill. An edict exempted him from court audiences.

sentences.zh: 是月，大駕時巡上都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial procession made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the imperial procession made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 永懷縣賊陷桂陽。

translations.literal: Bandits of Yonghuai County captured Guiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits of Yonghuai County captured Guiyang.

sentences.zh: 咬住復歸州，進攻峽州，與峽州總管趙余褫大破賊兵，誅賊將李太素等，遂平之。

translations.literal: Qiaozhu recovered Guizhou, advanced to attack Xizhou, and with Zhao Yuchi, prefect of Xizhou, routed the bandit army, executed the bandit generals Li Taisu and others, and pacified the region.
translations.idiomatic: Qiaozhu recovered Guizhou, advanced to attack Xizhou, and with Zhao Yuchi, prefect of Xizhou, routed the bandit army, executed the bandit generals Li Taisu and others, and pacified the region.

sentences.zh: 詔天下完城郭，築堤防。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the empire to repair city walls and build dikes and embankments.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the empire to repair city walls and build dikes and embankments.

sentences.zh: 命亦都護月魯帖木兒領畏吾兒軍馬，同豫王阿剌忒納失裏、知樞密院事老章討襄陽、南陽、鄧州賊。

translations.literal: Yiduoyue Lute Temür, commander-in-chief of the Uighurs, was ordered to lead Uighur troops and horses, and together with Prince Alatenashili and Lao Zhang, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, to campaign against bandits in Xiangyang, Nanyang, and Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yiduoyue Lute Temür, commander-in-chief of the Uighurs, was ordered to lead Uighur troops and horses and, together with Prince Alatenashili and Lao Zhang, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, to campaign against bandits in Xiangyang, Nanyang, and Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 陜西行臺監察御史蒙古魯海牙、範文等糾言也先帖木兒喪師辱國，乞明正其罪，詔不允。

translations.literal: Mongoluhaiya and Fan Wen, supervising censors of the Shaanxi branch censorate, and others impeached Yesun Temür for losing troops and disgracing the state and requested that his crime be clearly defined; an edict did not grant the request.
translations.idiomatic: Mongoluhaiya and Fan Wen, supervising censors of the Shaanxi branch censorate, and others impeached Yesun Temür for losing troops and disgracing the state and requested that his crime be clearly defined. An edict did not grant the request.

sentences.zh: 左遷西臺御史大夫朵爾直班為湖廣行省平章政事，蒙古魯海牙十二人為各路添設佐貳官。

translations.literal: Duo'erzhiban, censor-in-chief of the western branch censorate, was demoted to chief minister of the Huguang branch secretariat, and Mongoluhaiya and twelve others were made additional deputy officials in the various circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Duo'erzhiban, censor-in-chief of the western branch censorate, was demoted to chief minister of the Huguang branch secretariat, and Mongoluhaiya and twelve others were made additional deputy officials in the various circuits.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉朔，太白犯鎮星。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on the guiyou new moon, Venus transgressed Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the guiyou new moon, Venus transgressed Saturn.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，命龍虎山張嗣德為三十九代天師，給印章。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Zhang Side of Longhu Mountain was appointed thirty-ninth generation Celestial Master and granted a seal.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Zhang Side of Longhu Mountain was appointed thirty-ninth-generation Celestial Master and granted a seal.

sentences.zh: 海道萬戶李世安建言權停夏運，從之。

translations.literal: Li Shi'an, myriarch of the sea route, proposed temporarily suspending the summer transport; the proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shi'an, myriarch of the sea route, proposed temporarily suspending the summer transport. The proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 命江南行臺御史大夫納麟給宣敕與臺州民陳子由、楊恕卿、趙士正、戴甲，令其集民丁夾攻方國珍。

translations.literal: Nalin, censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan branch censorate, was ordered to grant edicts of appointment to the Taizhou commoners Chen Ziyou, Yang Shuqing, Zhao Shizheng, and Dai Jia, commanding them to gather militia for a pincer attack on Fang Guozhen.
translations.idiomatic: Nalin, censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan branch censorate, was ordered to grant edicts of appointment to the Taizhou commoners Chen Ziyou, Yang Shuqing, Zhao Shizheng, and Dai Jia, commanding them to gather militia for a pincer attack on Fang Guozhen.

sentences.zh: 己卯，咬住復中興路。

translations.literal: On jimao day, Qiaozhu recovered Zhongxing Route.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Qiaozhu recovered Zhongxing Route.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，監察御史徹徹帖木兒等言：「河南諸處群盜，輒引亡宋故號以為口實，宜以瀛國公子和尚趙完普及親屬徙沙州安置，禁勿與人交通。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Supervising Censor Cheche Temür and others said: "Bandits in various places in Henan repeatedly invoke the old titles of the fallen Song as their pretext. The monk Zhao Wanpu, son of Emperor Ying, and his kin should be relocated to Shazhou and forbidden to communicate with others.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Supervising Censor Cheche Temür and others said: "Bandits in various places in Henan repeatedly invoke the old titles of the fallen Song as their pretext. The monk Zhao Wanpu, son of Emperor Ying, and his kin should be relocated to Shazhou and forbidden to communicate with others.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: "The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: "The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 罷幹兒棚等處金銀場課。

translations.literal: The tax on gold and silver mines at Gan'erpeng and other places was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The tax on gold and silver mines at Gan'erpeng and other places was abolished.

sentences.zh: 癸未，建昌民戴良起鄉兵克復建昌路。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, Dai Liang of Jianchang raised local militia and recovered Jianchang Route.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Dai Liang of Jianchang raised local militia and recovered Jianchang Route.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，命留守帖木哥與諸王朵兒只守口北龍慶州。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Temuge, chief steward, and Prince Duo'erzhi were ordered to defend Longqing Prefecture north of the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Temuge, chief steward, and Prince Duo'erzhi were ordered to defend Longqing Prefecture north of the passes.

sentences.zh: 是月，答失八都魯至荊門，增募兵，趨襄陽，與賊戰，大敗克之。

translations.literal: That month, Dashibadoulu reached Jingmen, raised additional troops, hastened to Xiangyang, fought the bandits, and routed them in a great victory.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Dashibadoulu reached Jingmen, raised additional troops, and hastened to Xiangyang. He fought the bandits and routed them in a great victory.

sentences.zh: 命左答納失裏仍守蕪湖險隘。

translations.literal: Zuodanashili was ordered to continue holding the strategic passes at Wuhu.
translations.idiomatic: Zuodanashili was ordered to continue holding the strategic passes at Wuhu.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午，中書省臣言，大名路開、滑、浚三州、元城十一縣水旱蟲蝗，饑民七十一萬六千九百八十口，給鈔十萬錠賑之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on bingwu day, ministers of the Secretariat reported that in Kai, Hua, and Jun, three prefectures of Daming Route, and eleven counties of Yuancheng, drought, flood, locusts, and famine had afflicted seven hundred sixteen thousand nine hundred eighty mouths; one hundred thousand ingots of notes were granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the bingwu day, ministers of the Secretariat reported that in Kai, Hua, and Jun, three prefectures of Daming Route, and eleven counties of Yuancheng, drought, flood, locusts, and famine had afflicted seven hundred sixteen thousand nine hundred eighty people. One hundred thousand ingots of notes were granted for relief.

sentences.zh: 戊申，命治書侍御史杜秉彜、中書參議李稷並兼經筵官。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Du Bingyi, investigating censor, and Li Ji, secretariat counsellor, were both appointed concurrently as Classics Colloquium officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Du Bingyi, investigating censor, and Li Ji, secretariat counsellor, were both appointed concurrently as Classics Colloquium officials.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，太白犯井宿。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, Venus transgressed the Well constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Venus transgressed the Well constellation.

sentences.zh: 河南行省左丞匝納祿、參知政事王也速叠兒，並以失誤軍需，左遷添設淮西宣慰使，隨軍供給。

translations.literal: Zanalu, left vice director of the Henan branch secretariat, and Wang Yesudie'er, vice grand councillor, were both demoted for errors in military supplies to additional pacification commissioners of western Huai and ordered to follow the army in providing supplies.
translations.idiomatic: Zanalu, left vice director of the Henan branch secretariat, and Wang Yesudie'er, vice grand councillor, were both demoted for errors in military supplies to additional pacification commissioners of western Huai and ordered to follow the army in providing supplies.

sentences.zh: 命河南行省平章政事禿魯、參知政事李猷供給汝寧軍需。

translations.literal: Tulu, chief minister of the Henan branch secretariat, and Li You, vice grand councillor, were ordered to supply the military needs of the Runing army.
translations.idiomatic: Tulu, chief minister of the Henan branch secretariat, and Li You, vice grand councillor, were ordered to supply the military needs of the Runing army.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，賜中書參知政事悟良哈臺珠衣並帽。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Wulianghatai, vice grand councillor of the Secretariat, was granted a pearl robe and cap.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Wulianghatai, vice grand councillor of the Secretariat, was granted a pearl robe and cap.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，宣讓王帖木兒不花，諸王乞塔歹、曲憐帖木兒及淮南廉訪使班祝兒並平賊有功，賜金系腰、銀、鈔有差。

translations.literal: On yichou day, Prince of Xuanrang Temür Buhua, Princes Qitadai and Qulian Temür, and Banzhu'er, surveillance commissioner of Huainan, all had merit in pacifying bandits and were granted golden girdles, silver, and notes in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Prince of Xuanrang Temür Buhua, Princes Qitadai and Qulian Temür, and Banzhu'er, surveillance commissioner of Huainan, all had merit in pacifying bandits and were granted golden girdles, silver, and notes in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 紹慶宣慰使楊延禮不花遙授湖廣左丞，楊伯顏卜花為紹慶宣慰使，換文資；

translations.literal: Yang Yanlibuhua, pacification commissioner of Shaoqing, was remotely appointed left vice director of Huguang; Yang Boyanbuhua was made pacification commissioner of Shaoqing, with a transfer to civil rank;
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yanlibuhua, pacification commissioner of Shaoqing, was remotely appointed left vice director of Huguang; Yang Boyanbuhua was made pacification commissioner of Shaoqing, with a transfer to civil rank;

sentences.zh: 楊城為沿邊溪洞招討使兼征行萬戶，回賜先所拘收牌面。

translations.literal: Yang Cheng was made pacification commissioner of the frontier streams and caves and concurrently campaigning myriarch, and the tally plaques previously confiscated from him were returned.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Cheng was made pacification commissioner of the frontier streams and caves and concurrently campaigning myriarch, and the tally plaques previously confiscated from him were returned.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，紅巾周伯顏陷道州。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, Zhou Boyan of the Red Turbans captured Daozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Zhou Boyan of the Red Turbans captured Daozhou.

sentences.zh: 修太廟西神門。

translations.literal: The western spirit gate of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: The western spirit gate of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was repaired.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，時享太廟。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on dingchou day, seasonal offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the dingchou day, seasonal offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，饒、徽賊犯昱嶺關，陷杭州路。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, bandits of Raozhou and Huizhou attacked Yuling Pass and captured Hangzhou Route.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, bandits of Raozhou and Huizhou attacked Yuling Pass and captured Hangzhou Route.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命通政院使答兒麻失裏與樞密副使禿堅不花討徐州賊，給敕牒三十道以賞功。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, Darmashili, commissioner of the Bureau of Transmission, and Tujianbuhua, vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, were ordered to campaign against bandits in Xuzhou; thirty edict slips were granted for rewarding merit.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Darmashili, commissioner of the Bureau of Transmission, and Tujianbuhua, vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, were ordered to campaign against bandits in Xuzhou. Thirty edict slips were granted for rewarding merit.

sentences.zh: 己丑，湘鄉賊陷寶慶路。

translations.literal: On jichou day, bandits of Xiangxiang captured Baoqing Route.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, bandits of Xiangxiang captured Baoqing Route.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以殺獲西番首賊功，賜岐王阿剌乞巴鈔一千錠，邠王嵬厘、諸王班的失監、平章政事鎖南班各金系腰一。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, for merit in killing and capturing the chief bandits of the western tribes, Prince of Qi Alaqiba was granted one thousand ingots of notes; Prince of Bin Weili, Prince Bandeshijian, and Chief Minister Suonanban were each granted one golden girdle.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, for merit in killing and capturing the chief bandits of the western tribes, Prince of Qi Alaqiba was granted one thousand ingots of notes; Prince of Bin Weili, Prince Bandeshijian, and Chief Minister Suonanban were each granted one golden girdle.

sentences.zh: 以征西元帥斡羅為章佩添設少監，討徐州。

translations.literal: Woluo, marshal of the western campaign, was appointed additional vice director of the Directorate of Insignia and ordered to campaign against Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Woluo, marshal of the western campaign, was appointed additional vice director of the Directorate of Insignia and ordered to campaign against Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 脫脫請親出師討徐州，詔許之。

translations.literal: Toqto requested to lead the campaign against Xuzhou in person; an edict granted the request.
translations.idiomatic: Toqto requested to lead the campaign against Xuzhou in person. An edict granted the request.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命脫脫臺為行樞密院使，提調二十萬戶，賜金系腰一、銀鈔幣帛有差。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Toqto was appointed director of the Mobile Bureau of Military Affairs, with command over two hundred thousand households, and was granted one golden girdle and varying amounts of silver, notes, silks, and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Toqto was appointed director of the mobile Bureau of Military Affairs, with command over two hundred thousand households, and was granted one golden girdle and varying amounts of silver, notes, silks, and cloth.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，辰星犯靈臺。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Mercury transgressed the Spirit Tower.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Mercury transgressed the Spirit Tower.

sentences.zh: 以杜秉彜為中書添設參知政事。

translations.literal: Du Bingyi was appointed additional vice grand councillor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Du Bingyi was appointed additional vice grand councillor of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 湖南元帥副使小雲失海牙、總管兀顏思忠復寶慶路。

translations.literal: Xiaoyunshihaiya, deputy marshal of Hunan, and Wuyansi Zhong, prefect, recovered Baoqing Route.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoyunshihaiya, deputy marshal of Hunan, and Wuyansi Zhong, prefect, recovered Baoqing Route.

sentences.zh: 是月，徐壽輝偽將王善、康壽四、江二蠻等陷福安、寧德等縣。

translations.literal: That month, Wang Shan, Kang Shousi, Jiang Erman, and other rebel generals of Xu Shouhui captured Fu'an, Ningde, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Wang Shan, Kang Shousi, Jiang Erman, and other rebel generals of Xu Shouhui captured Fu'an, Ningde, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，命中書參知政事帖理帖木爾、淮南行省右丞蠻子供給脫脫行軍一應所需。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on guimao day, Tili Temür, vice grand councillor of the Secretariat, and Manzi, right vice director of the Huainan branch secretariat, were ordered to supply all needs of Toqto's field army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the guimao day, Tili Temür, vice grand councillor of the Secretariat, and Manzi, right vice director of the Huainan branch secretariat, were ordered to supply all needs of Toqto's field army.

sentences.zh: 方國珍率其眾攻臺州城，浙東元帥也忒迷失、福建元帥黑的兒擊退之。

translations.literal: Fang Guozhen led his followers to attack Taizhou city; Yetimishi, marshal of eastern Zhejiang, and Hei'er'er, marshal of Fujian, repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Guozhen led his followers to attack Taizhou city. Yetimishi, marshal of eastern Zhejiang, and Hei'er'er, marshal of Fujian, repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以同知樞密院事哈麻為中書添設右丞。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, Hama, vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed additional right vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Hama, vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed additional right vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 齊王失列門獻馬一萬五千匹於京師。

translations.literal: Prince of Qi Shiliemen presented fifteen thousand horses at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Qi Shiliemen presented fifteen thousand horses at the capital.

sentences.zh: 賜脫脫金三錠，銀三十錠，鈔一萬錠，幣、帛各一千匹。

translations.literal: Toqto was granted three ingots of gold, thirty ingots of silver, ten thousand ingots of notes, and one thousand bolts each of silks and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Toqto was granted three ingots of gold, thirty ingots of silver, ten thousand ingots of notes, and one thousand bolts each of silks and cloth.

sentences.zh: 丁未，日本國白高麗賊過海剽掠，身稱島居民，高麗國王伯顏帖木兒調兵剿捕之，賜金系腰一、鈔二千錠。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, bandits from Japan and Goryeo crossed the sea to plunder, claiming to be island dwellers; King Boyan Temür of Goryeo mobilized troops to suppress and capture them and was granted one golden girdle and two thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, bandits from Japan and Goryeo crossed the sea to plunder, claiming to be island dwellers. King Boyan Temür of Goryeo mobilized troops to suppress and capture them and was granted one golden girdle and two thousand ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命知樞密院事咬咬、中書平章政事搠思監、也可紥魯忽赤福壽，並從脫脫出師征徐州，賜金系腰及銀、鈔、幣、帛有差。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Yao Yao, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Suosijian, chief minister of the Secretariat, and Fushou, yekejarquchi, were all ordered to follow Toqto on campaign against Xuzhou and were granted golden girdles and varying amounts of silver, notes, silks, and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Yao Yao, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Suosijian, chief minister of the Secretariat, and Fushou, yekejarquchi, were all ordered to follow Toqto on campaign against Xuzhou and were granted golden girdles and varying amounts of silver, notes, silks, and cloth.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士承旨闊怯鎮遏五投下百姓，賜金系腰一。

translations.literal: Kuoqie, academician exhorter-in-chief, pacified the people of the five touxia and was granted one golden girdle.
translations.idiomatic: Kuoqie, academician exhorter-in-chief, pacified the people of the five touxia and was granted one golden girdle.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以紥撒溫孫為河南行省右丞，偰哲篤為淮南行省左丞，各賜鈔五十錠。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Zhasawen'sun was appointed right vice director of the Henan branch secretariat and Yizhedu was appointed left vice director of the Huainan branch secretariat; each was granted fifty ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Zhasawen'sun was appointed right vice director of the Henan branch secretariat and Yizhedu was appointed left vice director of the Huainan branch secretariat. Each was granted fifty ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以禿思迷失為淮南行省平章政事。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Tusimishi was appointed chief minister of the Huainan branch secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Tusimishi was appointed chief minister of the Huainan branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命中書平章政事普化知經筵事。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Puhua, chief minister of the Secretariat, was appointed director of the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Puhua, chief minister of the Secretariat, was appointed director of the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 脫脫將出師，六部尚書密邇麻和謨等上言：「大臣天子之股肱，中書庶政之根本，不可以一日離。

translations.literal: As Toqto was about to take the field, Mierimahemo and other ministers of the six ministries submitted a memorial: "Great ministers are the emperor's arms and legs, and the Secretariat is the root of all government; they cannot be separated from him for a single day.
translations.idiomatic: As Toqto was about to take the field, Mierimahemo and other ministers of the six ministries submitted a memorial: "Great ministers are the emperor's arms and legs, and the Secretariat is the root of all government; they cannot be separated from him for a single day.

sentences.zh: 乞詔留賢相，弼亮天工，如此則內外有兼治之宜，社稷有倚重之寄。

translations.literal: We beg that an edict retain the worthy minister to assist and illumine the work of Heaven; thus within and without there will be the fitness of joint governance, and the altars of state will have one on whom to rely.
translations.idiomatic: We beg that an edict retain the worthy minister to assist and illumine the work of Heaven. Thus within and without there will be the fitness of joint governance, and the altars of state will have one on whom to rely.

sentences.zh: 」不報。

translations.literal: "No reply was received.
translations.idiomatic: "No reply was received.

sentences.zh: 脫脫言，皇后斡耳朵思支用不敷，自今為始，每年宜給金一十錠、銀五十錠。

translations.literal: Toqto reported that the expenditures of the empress's ordo were insufficient; from this time forward, ten ingots of gold and fifty ingots of silver should be granted each year.
translations.idiomatic: Toqto reported that the expenditures of the empress's ordo were insufficient. From this time forward, ten ingots of gold and fifty ingots of silver should be granted each year.

sentences.zh: 以同知樞密院事雪雪出軍南陽，同知樞密院事禿赤出軍河南，皆有功，各進階榮祿大夫。

translations.literal: Xuexue, vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, took the field at Nanyang, and Tuchi, vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, took the field at Henan; both had merit and were each promoted to Grand Master for Glorious Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: Xuexue, vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, took the field at Nanyang, and Tuchi, vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, took the field at Henan. Both had merit and were each promoted to Grand Master for Glorious Happiness.

sentences.zh: 中書左丞哈麻進階榮祿大夫。

translations.literal: Hama, left vice director of the Secretariat, was promoted to Grand Master for Glorious Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: Hama, left vice director of the Secretariat, was promoted to Grand Master for Glorious Happiness.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命哈麻等提調各怯薛、各愛馬口糧。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Hama and others were ordered to take charge of rations for the various keshik and horse guards.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Hama and others were ordered to take charge of rations for the various keshik and horse guards.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太白犯歲星。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, Venus transgressed Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, Venus transgressed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 詔：「脫脫以答剌罕、太傅、中書右丞相分省於外，督制諸處軍馬，討徐州。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Toqto, as darughachi, grand preceptor, and right chief minister of the Secretariat, shall establish a branch secretariat in the field, supervise all armies in the various places, and campaign against Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Toqto, as darughachi, grand preceptor, and right chief minister of the Secretariat, shall establish a branch secretariat in the field, supervise all armies in the various places, and campaign against Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 中書省、樞密院、御史臺分官屬從行，稟受節制，爵賞有功，誅殺有罪，綏順討逆，悉聽便宜從事。

translations.literal: Officials of the Secretariat, Bureau of Military Affairs, and Censorate shall be detached to accompany the campaign, receive his orders, ennoble the meritorious, execute the guilty, pacify the compliant and punish the rebellious — all at his discretionary command.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the Secretariat, Bureau of Military Affairs, and Censorate shall be detached to accompany the campaign, receive his orders, ennoble the meritorious, execute the guilty, pacify the compliant and punish the rebellious — all at his discretionary command.

sentences.zh: 」是日，發京師。

translations.literal: "That day, he departed from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: "That day, he departed from the capital.

sentences.zh: 是月，大駕還大都。

translations.literal: That month, the imperial procession returned to Dadu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the imperial procession returned to Dadu.

sentences.zh: 安陸賊將俞君正復陷荊門州，知州聶炳死之。

translations.literal: The rebel general Yu Junzheng of Anlu again seized Jingmen Prefecture; Prefect Nie Bing died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel general Yu Junzheng of Anlu again captured Jingmen Prefecture, and Prefect Nie Bing was killed.

sentences.zh: 賊將黨仲達復陷岳州。

translations.literal: The rebel general Dang Zhongda again seized Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel general Dang Zhongda again captured Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，俞君正復陷中興，咬住領兵與戰於樓臺，敗績，奔松滋，本路判官上都死之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on yihai day, Yu Junzheng again seized Zhongxing; Qipchaq led troops to fight him at Loutai, suffered defeat, and fled to Songzi; Shangdu, judicial intendant of the circuit, died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the yihai day, Yu Junzheng again captured Zhongxing. Qipchaq led troops against him at Loutai but was defeated and fled to Songzi. Shangdu, judicial intendant of the circuit, was killed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，監察御史及河南分御史臺、行樞密院、河南廉訪司、鞏昌總帥府、陜西都府、義兵萬戶府等官，交章言御史大夫也先帖木兒出征河南功績。

translations.literal: On jimao day, supervising censors and officials of the Henan branch censorate, branch Bureau of Military Affairs, Henan surveillance commission, Gongchang commander-in-chief's headquarters, Shaanxi metropolitan command, and righteous-army office of ten thousand households submitted successive memorials reporting the achievements of Censor-in-Chief Yesen Temür in the Henan campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, supervising censors and officials of the Henan branch censorate, branch Bureau of Military Affairs, Henan surveillance commission, Gongchang commander-in-chief's headquarters, Shaanxi metropolitan command, and righteous-army office of ten thousand households submitted successive memorials praising the achievements of Censor-in-Chief Yesen Temür in the Henan campaign.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，賜也先帖木兒金系腰一、金一錠、銀一十錠、鈔五千錠、幣帛各一百匹。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Yesen Temür was granted one gold belt plaque, one ingot of gold, ten ingots of silver, five thousand ingots of paper money, and one hundred bolts each of silks and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Yesen Temür was granted one gold belt plaque, one ingot of gold, ten ingots of silver, five thousand ingots of paper money, and one hundred bolts each of silks and cloth.

sentences.zh: 癸未，中興義士範中，偕荊門僧李智率義兵復中興路，俞君正敗走，龍鎮衛指揮使俺都剌哈蠻領兵入城，咬住自松滋還，屯兵於石馬。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, Fan Zhong, a righteous gentleman of Zhongxing, together with the monk Li Zhi of Jingmen, led righteous troops to recover Zhongxing Circuit; Yu Junzheng was defeated and fled; Andar Hama, commander of Longzhen Guard, led troops into the city; Qipchaq returned from Songzi and encamped his troops at Shima.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Fan Zhong, a loyalist of Zhongxing, together with the monk Li Zhi of Jingmen, led volunteer troops to recover Zhongxing Circuit. Yu Junzheng was defeated and fled. Andar Hama, commander of Longzhen Guard, led troops into the city, while Qipchaq returned from Songzi and encamped at Shima.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，脫脫至徐州。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Toqto arrived at Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Toqto arrived at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命知行樞密院事阿剌吉從脫脫討徐州，賜金系腰一，金一錠，銀五錠，鈔、幣有差。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Alachi, acting director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was ordered to follow Toqto in campaigning against Xuzhou and was granted one gold belt plaque, one ingot of gold, five ingots of silver, and graded amounts of paper money and silks.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Alachi, acting director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was ordered to follow Toqto in the campaign against Xuzhou and was granted one gold belt plaque, one ingot of gold, five ingots of silver, and graded amounts of paper money and silks.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，脫脫復徐州，屠其城，芝麻李等遁走。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Toqto recovered Xuzhou, slaughtered the inhabitants of the city, and Sesame Li and the others fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Toqto recovered Xuzhou, put the city to the sword, and Sesame Li and the others fled.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太陰犯軒轅。

translations.literal: On renchen day, the moon transgressed the Chariot Shafts asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, the moon transgressed the Chariot Shafts asterism.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，賜哈麻李三百錠買玉帶。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, Hama was granted three hundred ingots of paper money to purchase a jade belt.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, Hama was granted three hundred ingots of paper money to purchase a jade belt.

sentences.zh: 己亥，賊攻辰州，達魯花赤和尚擊走之。

translations.literal: On jihai day, bandits attacked Chenzhou; the darughachi Heshang drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, bandits attacked Chenzhou, and the darughachi Heshang drove them off.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔加脫脫為太師，班師還京。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, an edict added Toqto to the post of grand preceptor, and the army withdrew and returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, an edict appointed Toqto grand preceptor, and his army withdrew and returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，時享太廟。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, on dingwei day, seasonal offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingwei day, seasonal offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，知樞密院事老章進階金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Lao Zhang, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was advanced to Grand Master of the Golden Purple and Blue-Green Girdle.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Lao Zhang, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was promoted to Grand Master of the Golden Purple and Blue-Green Girdle.

sentences.zh: 命平章定住、右丞哈麻同知經筵事。

translations.literal: Chief Minister Dingzhu and Right Vice Director Hama were ordered to serve jointly as directors of the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Minister Dingzhu and Right Vice Director Hama were appointed joint directors of the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命和糴粟豆五十萬石於遼陽。

translations.literal: On guichou day, an order was issued to purchase five hundred thousand piculs of grain and beans in Liaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, an order was issued to purchase five hundred thousand piculs of grain and beans in Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，拜知行樞密院事阿乞剌為太尉、淮南行省平章政事。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Aqila, acting director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed grand marshal and chief minister of the Huainan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Aqila, acting director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed grand marshal and chief minister of the Huainan branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 戊午，太陰犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, the moon transgressed the Ghost mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, the moon transgressed the Ghost mansion.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太陰犯歲星。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, the moon transgressed Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the moon transgressed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，太陰犯亢宿。

translations.literal: On yichou day, the moon transgressed the Neck mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, the moon transgressed the Neck mansion.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，命江浙行省平章政事慶童收捕常州賊。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on xinwei day, Qing Tong, chief minister of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, was ordered to capture the bandits of Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the xinwei day, Qing Tong, chief minister of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, was ordered to capture the bandits of Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以星吉為江西行省平章政事，出師湖廣。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Singgi was appointed chief minister of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat and took the field in Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Singgi was appointed chief minister of the Jiangxi branch secretariat and marched into Huguang.

sentences.zh: 丙子，中書省臣請為脫脫立《徐州平寇碑》及加封王爵。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, ministers of the Secretariat requested that a stele entitled "Pacification of Bandits at Xuzhou" be erected for Toqto and that he be enfeoffed with a princely title.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, ministers of the Secretariat requested that a stele entitled "Pacification of Bandits at Xuzhou" be erected for Toqto and that he be enfeoffed as a prince.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命江浙行省右丞帖裏帖木兒總兵討方國珍。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, Tore Temür, right vice director of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, was ordered to command troops in campaigning against Fang Guozhen.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Tore Temür, right vice director of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, was ordered to command troops against Fang Guozhen.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以脫脫平徐功，賜金一十錠、銀一百錠、鈔五萬錠、幣帛各三千匹，上表辭，從之。

translations.literal: On jichou day, because of Toqto's achievement in pacifying Xuzhou, he was granted ten ingots of gold, one hundred ingots of silver, fifty thousand ingots of paper money, and three thousand bolts each of silks and cloth; he submitted a memorial declining them, and the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, because of Toqto's achievement in pacifying Xuzhou, he was granted ten ingots of gold, one hundred ingots of silver, fifty thousand ingots of paper money, and three thousand bolts each of silks and cloth. He submitted a memorial declining the gifts, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，太陰犯太微垣。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, the moon transgressed the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，答失八都魯復襄陽。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on renyin day, Darmashiri recovered Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the renyin day, Darmashiri recovered Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔以杭、常、湖、信、廣德諸路皆克復，赦詿誤者，蠲其夏稅、秋糧，命有司撫恤其民。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, an edict stated that because the routes of Hangzhou, Changzhou, Huzhou, Xinzhou, and Guangde had all been recovered, those who had been misled into error were pardoned, their summer tax and autumn grain were remitted, and the responsible offices were ordered to comfort and care for the people.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, an edict stated that because the routes of Hangzhou, Changzhou, Huzhou, Xinzhou, and Guangde had all been recovered, those who had been misled into rebellion were pardoned, their summer tax and autumn grain were remitted, and local officials were ordered to comfort and care for the people.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以湖廣行省參知政事卜顏不花、右丞阿兒灰討徭賊，復湖南潭、嶽等處有功，卜顏不花升散階從一品，阿兒灰升正二品。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, because Buyan Buhua, vice grand councillor of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, and Arhui, right vice director, had campaigned against Yao bandits and recovered Tanzhou, Yuezhou, and other places in Hunan with merit, Buyan Buhua was promoted to the honorary first rank of the second grade and Arhui to the regular second grade.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, because Buyan Buhua, vice grand councillor of the Huguang branch secretariat, and Arhui, right vice director, had campaigned against Yao bandits and recovered Tanzhou, Yuezhou, and other places in Hunan with merit, Buyan Buhua was promoted to the honorary first rank of the second grade and Arhui to the regular second grade.

sentences.zh: 癸未，脫脫言：「京畿近地水利，召募江南人耕種，歲可得粟麥百萬餘石，不煩海運而京師足食。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, Toqto reported: "By developing the water resources of the lands near the capital region and recruiting people from Jiangnan to cultivate them, more than a million piculs of grain and wheat could be obtained each year, so that the capital would have sufficient food without relying on sea transport.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Toqto reported: "By developing the water resources of the lands near the capital region and recruiting cultivators from Jiangnan, more than a million piculs of grain and wheat could be obtained each year, so that the capital would have sufficient food without relying on sea transport.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「此事有利於國家，其議行之。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "This matter benefits the state; deliberate on it and carry it out."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "This matter benefits the state. Deliberate on it and carry it out."

sentences.zh: 」是歲，海運不通。

translations.literal: That year, sea transport was cut off.
translations.idiomatic: That year, sea transport was cut off.

sentences.zh: 立都水庸田使司於汴梁，掌種植之事。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Waterways and Corvée Fields was established at Bianliang to oversee planting affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The directorate of waterways and corvée fields was established at Bianliang to oversee agricultural planting.

sentences.zh: 潁州沈丘人察罕帖木兒與信陽州羅山人李思齊同起義兵，破賊有功，授察罕帖木兒中順大夫、汝寧府達魯花赤，李思齊知汝寧府。

translations.literal: Chaghan Temur of Shenqiu in Yingzhou and Li Sicheng of Luoshan in Xinyang Prefecture together raised righteous troops, defeated bandits with merit, and were appointed: Chaghan Temur as Grand Master for Fostering Accordance and darughachi of Runing Prefecture, and Li Sicheng as prefect of Runing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Chaghan Temur of Shenqiu in Yingzhou and Li Sicheng of Luoshan in Xinyang Prefecture together raised volunteer troops and defeated bandits with merit. Chaghan Temur was appointed Grand Master for Fostering Accordance and darughachi of Runing Prefecture, and Li Sicheng was appointed prefect of Runing Prefecture.
